words.exampleTranslation: 每个制造商都有几种可能的选择。

words.translation: n&vt. 战胜， 挫败
words.example: They narrowly avoided defeat.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们险些儿被打败。

words.translation: 有效的， 正当的；adj. 有根据的， 有理的
words.example: All tickets are valid for two months.
words.exampleTranslation: 所有的票在两个月内有效。

words.translation: 不活动， 惰性；n. 惯性
words.example: We must remember that some people have a greater inertia than others.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们必须记住，有些人比其他人更有惰性。

words.translation: 鼓励， 怂恿；vt. 促进， 助长， 激发
words.example: Parents encourage every activity imaginable.
words.exampleTranslation: 父母鼓励一切可能的活动。

words.translation: 收集；v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；真空；n. 真空吸尘器
words.example: Vacuum cleaners work by suction.
words.exampleTranslation: 真空吸尘器靠抽吸除尘。

words.translation: 奢侈的；adj. 过度的， 过分的， 放肆的
words.example: She's got very extravagant tastes.
words.exampleTranslation: 她有很奢侈的嗜好。

words.translation: 容纳； 向…提供住处；vt. 使适应， 顺应
words.example: There is usually room to accommodate up to 80 visitors.
words.exampleTranslation: 通常可以多能容纳80名来宾。

words.translation: vi. 冒泡， 起泡， 沸腾；泡，泡沫，水泡，气泡；n. 幻想的计划
words.example: Add the white wine and let it bubble up.
words.exampleTranslation: 加入白葡萄酒，让它产生泡沫。

words.translation: 道德， 道德性； 德行， 品行；n. 道德观， 道德规则
words.example: Standards of morality seem to be dropping.
words.exampleTranslation: 道德标准似乎在下降。

words.translation: 出产；让出，放弃；屈服，顺从；v. 倒塌，垮掉；n. 产量
words.example: He may yield control.
words.exampleTranslation: 他可能放弃控制权。

words.translation: adj. 电子的；电子学；n. 电子设备
words.example: His desk is covered with electronic gadgetry.
words.exampleTranslation: 他的书桌上摆满了各种电子装置。

words.translation: 移栽，移种；移植；vt. 使迁移，使移居；n. 移植
words.example: She was on a wait list for a liver transplant.
words.exampleTranslation: 她的名字当时在肝移植等候者名单上。

words.translation: 排屋；地坪，草坪；n.
words.example: All rooms have a balcony or terrace.
words.exampleTranslation: 所有的房间都有阳台或露台。

words.translation: n. 赤字， 亏空， 亏损
words.example: The deficit had grown with the connivance of the banks.
words.exampleTranslation: 在银行纵容下，赤字增加。

words.translation: 神圣的； 宗教的；adj. 神圣不可侵犯的
words.example: Cows are sacred to Hindus.
words.exampleTranslation: 印度教徒把牛奉为圣物。

words.translation: n. 大教堂
words.example: The cathedral dominates the city.
words.exampleTranslation: 大教堂俯视全城。

words.translation: 优美的， 文雅的， 讲究的；adj. 简练的， 简洁的
words.example: She is always so chic, so elegant.
words.exampleTranslation: 她总是那么时髦，那么优雅。

words.translation: 综合；n. 合成
words.example: Instead, he advocates a synthesis of these two views.
words.exampleTranslation: 相反，他主张综合这两种观点。

words.translation: adv. 顺便提及地， 顺便提一句
words.example: Incidentally, have you heard the news about Sue?
words.exampleTranslation: 顺便问一句，你听说过休的事了吗？

words.translation: 地极的， 近地极的； 磁极的；adj. 正好相反的， 截然对立的
words.example: The polar vortex is a system of wintertime winds.
words.exampleTranslation: 极地涡旋是冬季风形成的一个风系。

words.translation: 鲨鱼；n. 勒索者， 诈骗者， 放高利贷的人
words.example: The shark described a circle around the shoal of fish.
words.exampleTranslation: 这条鲨鱼围绕着鱼群游动。

words.translation: 继续逗留， 留恋徘徊， 继续存留；vi. 缓慢消失
words.example: I slunk off in the direction of the cocktail table—the only place in the garden where a single man could linger without looking purposeless and alone.
words.exampleTranslation: 我偷偷朝鸡尾酒桌的方向溜去——这是花园中唯一一个可以让一个人在这里逗留而不会显得毫无目的和孤独的地方。

words.translation: n. 历史学家， 史学工作者
words.example: Historian Michael Beschloss debunks a few myths.
words.exampleTranslation: 历史学家迈克尔·贝斯切罗斯揭露了一些神话的真相。

words.translation: adj. 积累的， 渐增的
words.example: It's very close, but overall the cumulative effects of cloud are to cool Earth rather than heat it.
words.exampleTranslation: 这十分相近，但是总体上来说，云的累积作用是降低地球的温度而不是让地球升温。

words.translation: n. 原型
words.example: Chris Retzler has built a prototype of a machine called the wave rotor.
words.exampleTranslation: 克里斯·雷兹勒做出了一台叫做波转子的样机。

words.translation: n. 天桥， 立交桥
words.example: They'd taken refuge under an overpass to ride out the flames.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们在天桥下避难，从火中开车逃出来。

words.translation: n. 种， 类
words.example: This species is extremely rare.
words.exampleTranslation: 这一物种极为罕见。

words.translation: 滑跤，滑落，溜；下降，跌落；v. 悄悄放进；n. 疏漏， 差错
words.example: She allowed victory to slip from her grasp.
words.exampleTranslation: 她听任胜利从手中溜走。

words.translation: n. 气质， 性格
words.example: His only weakness is his temperament.
words.exampleTranslation: 他惟一的弱点是他的脾气。

words.translation: 引用， 引证； 传唤， 传讯；vt. 表彰， 嘉奖
words.example: Can you cite another case like this?
words.exampleTranslation: 你能举另外一个像这样的实例吗？

words.translation: 认识， 了解；n. 熟人
words.example: I am delighted to make your acquaintance, Mrs Baker.
words.exampleTranslation: 贝克太太，我很高兴与您相识。

words.translation: 呻吟，呜咽；vi. 抱怨，发牢骚；vt. 抱怨；呻吟声， 呜咽声；n. 怨声， 牢骚
words.example: Suddenly she gave a low, choking moan and began to tremble violently.
words.exampleTranslation: 突然她发出了一声低沉、令人窒息的呻吟，身体开始剧烈地抖动。

words.translation: 止；vt. 扑灭
words.example: He stopped to quench his thirst at a stream.
words.exampleTranslation: 他停在一条小溪边喝水解渴。

words.translation: 脱落，脱去；流出，流下；vt. 发出，散发；n. 棚， 小屋， 货棚
words.example: He was discovered hiding in a shed.
words.exampleTranslation: 人们发现他原来藏在棚屋里。

words.translation: 香料，调味品；n. 趣味，情趣，风味；使增添趣味；vt. 加香料于
words.example: The spice imparts an Eastern flavour to the dish.
words.exampleTranslation: 这种调味品会给菜肴添加一种东方风味。

words.translation: 等级， 品级， 评定结果；n. 收视率， 收听率
words.example: But Cahoot's overdraft rate depends on your credit rating.
words.exampleTranslation: 然而合伙人的透支率取决于你的信用等级。

words.translation: 断定的；adj. 过分自信的
words.example: Be assertive and spell out exactly how you feel.
words.exampleTranslation: 自信点，把你的真实感受详细说出来。

words.translation: 自治的；adj. 独立自主的
words.example: Five of the six provinces are to become autonomous regions in a new federal system of government.
words.exampleTranslation: 在新的联邦政府体制下，6个省中的5个将成为自治区。

words.translation: vi. 当裁判；裁判员；证明人，推荐人；n. 仲裁者，调解者
words.example: The referee stopped the fight.
words.exampleTranslation: 裁判叫停了那场拳击赛。

words.translation: 飞机的，航空的；adj. 空中的，架空的；n. 天线
words.example: The aerial doesn't look very secure to me.
words.exampleTranslation: 我看这天线不太牢固。

words.translation: 试， 试验； 审判；n. 讨厌的人
words.example: Their trial will shortly begin.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们的审讯很快就要开始。

words.translation: 感知， 觉察；n. 认识， 观念， 看法
words.example: She showed great perception in her assessment of the family situation.
words.exampleTranslation: 她对家庭状况的分析显示出敏锐的洞察力。

words.translation: vi. 消逝， 过去
words.example: Years probably would elapse before his return. Some of us might never see him again.
words.exampleTranslation: 他这一去可能就是多年，席上有些人恐怕今世也难得再见他面。

words.translation: 对称；n. 匀称， 整齐
words.example: Classical dance in its purest form requires symmetry and balance.
words.exampleTranslation: 真正的古典舞蹈要求对称与平衡。

words.translation: 想象；vt. 设想
words.example: He could not visualize her as old.
words.exampleTranslation: 他无法想像她年老的样子。

words.translation: 收割， 收获；vt. 获得， 得到
words.example: Machines that reap and thresh in one operation.
words.exampleTranslation: 同时完成收割和脱粒的机器。

words.translation: n. 昆虫， 虫
words.example: At rest the insect looks like a dead leaf.
words.exampleTranslation: 这种昆虫不动时看上去像一片枯叶。

words.translation: vi. 擅自行事；推测，假定，相信；冒昧，擅自；vt. 认定，推定
words.example: We must presume innocence until we have proof of guilt.
words.exampleTranslation: 在证实一个人有罪之前，我们必须假定其无辜。

words.translation: 补充，互为补充的东西；编制名额；装备定额；n. 补语['kɒmplɪm3nt]；vt. 补充， 与…相配
words.example: There will be a written examination to complement the practical test.
words.exampleTranslation: 会有一次书面考试来补充实践测试。

words.translation: n. 缆，索，电缆，电报；vt. 给… 发电报， 用电报传送
words.example: Rats had gnawed through the cable.
words.exampleTranslation: 老鼠把电缆咬断了。

words.translation: 令人讨厌的， 令人厌恶的； 难弄的， 困难的； 严重的， 恶劣的， 险恶的；adj. 下流的， 道德败坏的
words.example: That was a nasty little trick.
words.exampleTranslation: 这是个可恶的小骗局。

words.translation: 强烈的； 紧张的； 认真的；adj. 热情的
words.example: It was a period of intense activity.
words.exampleTranslation: 那是活动激烈的时期。

words.translation: vi. 近似， 与…接壤；n. 边，边缘，边界；给…加上边，围；vt. 邻接
words.example: They fled across the border.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们越过边界逃走了。

words.translation: n. 地产， 房地产
words.example: My father sold real estate.
words.exampleTranslation: 我父亲经营过房地产。

words.translation: 善于表达的， 发音清晰的；adj. 表达得清楚有力的；明确有力地表达；vt. 清楚地吐， 清晰地发
words.example: She is an articulate young woman.
words.exampleTranslation: 她是个善表达的年轻女子。

words.translation: 黏附， 附着； 遵守； 坚持；vi. 追随， 支持
words.example: One must be duly self-disciplined to adhere to it.
words.exampleTranslation: 人要适当自律才能坚持它。

words.translation: 花费， 消费， 费用；n. 开支， 业务费用
words.example: He can comfortably afford the extra expense.
words.exampleTranslation: 他支付这些额外的费用毫无问题。

words.translation: vt. 横渡， 横越
words.example: They don't like dense forests either, so they traverse these high, open shoulders between the river and the woods, where they can see and run.
words.exampleTranslation: 它们也不喜欢密集的树林，所以它们穿过河流和树林间这些高耸而开阔的山肩，在那里它们能够看到并奔跑。

words.translation: 严密的， 缜密的；adj. 严格的， 严厉的
words.example: The work failed to meet their rigorous standards.
words.exampleTranslation: 工作没有达到他们的严格标准。

words.translation: n&vi. 号叫， 叫喊
words.example: Her yell sent nearby grouse running for cover.
words.exampleTranslation: 她的喊声让附近的松鸡奔跑着四处躲藏。

words.translation: 现代的， 当代的；adj. 同时代的
words.example: Contemporary African cinema has much to offer.
words.exampleTranslation: 当代非洲电影制作艺术有很多贡献。

words.translation: 部落；n. 族
words.example: The valley is inhabited by the Dani tribe.
words.exampleTranslation: 这个山谷里居住着丹尼部落。

words.translation: 使活动起来；vt. 使开始作用
words.example: Anything from cosmic rays to radiation to diet may activate a dormant oncogene.
words.exampleTranslation: 从宇宙射线到辐射到日常饮食，任何东西都可能激活潜伏的致癌基因。

words.translation: vi. 动员起来；动员；vt. 调动，鼓动起
words.example: The troops were ordered to mobilize.
words.exampleTranslation: 部队接到了动员令。

words.translation: vi. 嘲笑，嘲弄；模拟的， 演习的；adj. 假的， 假装的；嘲笑，嘲弄；vt. 模仿
words.example: You can mock, but at least I'm willing to have a try!
words.exampleTranslation: 你可以嘲笑我，但我至少愿意试一试。

words.translation: n. 小型公共汽车
words.example: The schoolboy was knocked down by a minibus when crossing the street.
words.exampleTranslation: 那名男生过马路时被一辆小型公共汽车撞倒了。

words.translation: adj. 重复的， 反复性的
words.example: These tasks were repetitive, lengthy and lacking any intrinsic interest.
words.exampleTranslation: 这些作业重复冗长，没有什么意义。

words.translation: 齿轮，传动装置，挡；n. 用具，设备，衣服；vt. 使适应， 使适合
words.example: They cruised along in top gear.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们驾车高速行驶。

words.translation: vt. 使…变得容易， 使便利
words.example: The new airport will facilitate the development of tourism.
words.exampleTranslation: 新机场将促进旅游业的发展。

words.translation: 使突然发生； 猛然抛下；v. 使沉淀
words.example: I don't think we should make precipitate decisions.
words.exampleTranslation: 我认为我们不应该做出仓促的决定。

words.translation: 资助， 捐赠；vt. 给予， 赋予， 认为…具有某种特质
words.example: Herbs have been used for centuries to endow a whole range of foods with subtle flavours.
words.exampleTranslation: 香草几个世纪以来一直被用来赋予各种食品细腻的味道。

words.translation: adj. 财政的， 金融的
words.example: It's not just a financial matter.
words.exampleTranslation: 这不只是个财务问题。

words.translation: adj. 各自的， 各个的， 分别的
words.example: It is important that we dovetail our respective interests.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们寻求各自利益共同点是重要的。

words.translation: vi. 颤抖，发抖，抖动；n. 颤抖， 抖动， 颤声
words.example: Jane couldn't help the quiver in her voice.
words.exampleTranslation: 简不禁声音颤抖。

words.translation: 狭缝，狭槽；n. 位置，空位；把…放入狭长开口中；vt. 把…纳入其中， 使有位置
words.example: Somebody else can take your slot.
words.exampleTranslation: 别人可以取代你的位置。

words.translation: v. 变硬
words.example: Their action can only serve to harden the attitude of landowners.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们的举动只会使土地所有者们的态度变得强硬。

words.translation: v. 腐烂，腐朽；n. 腐烂， 腐朽
words.example: The house was riddled with dry rot.
words.exampleTranslation: 屋子因木材干腐而变得千疮百孔。

words.translation: vt. 给…下定义， 限定
words.example: We need to define the task ahead very clearly.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们需要明确今后的任务。

words.translation: vt. 预言， 预告， 预测
words.example: It is impossible to predict what will happen.
words.exampleTranslation: 预知未来的事是不可能的。

words.translation: v. ['dIkteIt]；口授；n. 命令， 规定， 要求
words.example: The choice that does this is "dictate".
words.exampleTranslation: 做到这一点的选择是“命令”。

words.translation: vt. 记住， 熟记
words.example: I don't try to memorize speeches word for word.
words.exampleTranslation: 我不会尝试去逐字地背那些演说。

words.translation: 使得， 致使； 给予， 提供；vt. 翻译
words.example: It's a concept that is difficult to render into English.
words.exampleTranslation: 这个概念难以用英语来表达。

words.translation: 暗中破坏， 逐渐削弱；vt. 侵蚀…的基础
words.example: He accused me of slandering him and trying to undermine his position.
words.exampleTranslation: 他指控我诽谤他并想削弱他的地位。

words.translation: adj. 主观的， 个人的
words.example: Everyone's opinion is bound to be subjective.
words.exampleTranslation: 每个人的意见都必定是主观的。

words.translation: 开花；vi. 发展， 长成；n. 花
words.example: The trees are in blossom.
words.exampleTranslation: 树上鲜花盛开。

words.translation: 根本的，基本的；adj. 激进的，激进派的；n. 激进分子
words.example: It was a radical departure from tradition.
words.exampleTranslation: 这从根本上违背了传统。

words.translation: adj. 明显的，显然的，明了的；显示， 表明， 证明；vt. 使显现， 使显露
words.example: If you take a look at his biography, you can get a good idea of how his life experiences manifest themselves in his theories of beauty.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果你看一下他的传记，就可以知道他的人生经历是如何体现在他的美学理论中的。

words.translation: 钝的；adj. 率直的，直言不讳的；使迟钝； 使减弱；vt. 使钝
words.example: The edge is as blunt as an old butter knife.
words.exampleTranslation: 刃钝得跟一把老黄油刀一样。

words.translation: n&v. 努力， 尽力， 尝试
words.example: I endeavor to find some peaceful places.
words.exampleTranslation: 我努力寻找一些宁静的地方。

words.translation: 使轻松， 使宽慰； 缓解， 减轻， 解除； 使得到调剂；vt. 接替， 替下
words.example: The doctor drew off some fluid to relieve the pressure.
words.exampleTranslation: 医生排掉了一些液体以缓解压力。

words.translation: n. 石英
words.example: Rocks like quartz, well, quartz of optical quality weren't cheap.
words.exampleTranslation: 具有像石英这样的光学品质的石头并不便宜。

words.translation: n. 空调设备， 空调系统
words.example: Air-conditioning is an absolute necessity in this climate.
words.exampleTranslation: 这样的气候绝对需要有空调。

words.translation: adj. 邻近的， 毗连的
words.example: The planes landed on adjacent runways.
words.exampleTranslation: 这些飞机在毗连的跑道上降落。

words.translation: 工作； 雇用；n. 使用
words.example: Employment is a very sensitive issue.
words.exampleTranslation: 就业是一个非常敏感的问题。

words.translation: vt. 运输；n. 运输， 运输工具
words.example: The goods were damaged during transport.
words.exampleTranslation: 货物在运输期间受损。

words.translation: 特有的；明确的；adj. 具体的；n. 详情， 细节
words.example: I gave you specific instructions.
words.exampleTranslation: 我给过你明确的指示。

words.translation: 比拟；n. 类比， 类推
words.example: The analogy between music and fragrance has stuck.
words.exampleTranslation: 音乐与香味的类比已经深入人心了。

words.translation: 申请， 申请书； 施用， 涂抹； 应用， 实施；n. 实用性
words.example: Her application was hurried through.
words.exampleTranslation: 她的申请很快得到了处理。

words.translation: 多产的， 富饶的；adj. 富有成效的
words.example: He was hopeful that the next round of talks would also be productive.
words.exampleTranslation: 他对下一轮会谈也会富有成效充满了希望。

words.translation: 修剪， 修整；vt. 删除， 削减
words.example: Prune rambling roses when the flowers have faded.
words.exampleTranslation: 花儿已经凋谢了的时候，修剪那些凌乱的蔷薇。

words.translation: v. 减少；n. [dI'kriːs]
words.example: People should decrease the amount of fat they eat.
words.exampleTranslation: 人们应减少脂肪的摄入量。

words.translation: 振翼，拍翅而飞；飘动，飘扬；vi. 快速跳动；n. 紧张， 激动不安
words.example: Her heart gave a flutter when she saw him.
words.exampleTranslation: 她见到他时心怦怦乱跳。

words.translation: 自愿； 自愿提供；v. 志愿；志愿者；n. 志愿兵
words.example: Volunteer work gives her life (a sense of) purpose.
words.exampleTranslation: 做志愿工作使她的生活有了意义。

words.translation: 部分重叠；v. 部分相同；n. 重叠， 重叠的部分
words.example: A fish's scales overlap each other.
words.exampleTranslation: 鱼鳞一片片上下交叠。

words.translation: n. 唯物主义
words.example: Scientific materialism thus triumphed over ignorance and superstition.
words.exampleTranslation: 科学唯物主义就这样战胜了无知和迷信。

words.translation: 分期付款， 分期交付；n. 部分
words.example: Martine puts it down to, among other things, soap operas and installment plans introduced in the 1970s.
words.exampleTranslation: 此外，玛蒂娜将其归因于20世纪70年代推出的肥皂剧和分期付款计划。

words.translation: 哀悼；v. 感到痛心
words.example: He does not mourn the demise of that world liberated from court etiquette, he says, he can call someone an "idiot" if he wants, instead of "Your Excellency".
words.exampleTranslation: 他说，他不会为这个从宫廷礼仪中解放出来的世界的消亡而哀悼，如果他愿意，他可以称某人为“白痴”，而不是“阁下”。

words.translation: 手杖；n. 茎
words.example: In his hand, he carried a gold-tipped cane.
words.exampleTranslation: 他手里拿着一根有金制端部的手杖。

words.translation: 嘲笑；vi. 轻视；n. 琐事，小事，无价值的东西
words.example: $1 000 is a mere trifle to her.
words.exampleTranslation: 1 000元对她来说不过是区区小数。

words.translation: 迁徙， 移栖；vi. 移居， 迁移
words.example: Swallows migrate south in winter.
words.exampleTranslation: 燕子在冬天迁徙到南方。

words.translation: n. 复活节
words.example: "Happy Easter," he yelled.
words.exampleTranslation: “复活节快乐，”他喊道。

words.translation: 屈从， 听从； 忍受；vi. 甘心；屈从，听从，服从；呈送，提交；vt. 主张，建议
words.example: Job applicants have to submit a specimen of handwriting.
words.exampleTranslation: 求职者必须提交一份笔迹样本。

words.translation: 新奇事物； 新奇， 新奇感， 新奇性；n. 新颖小巧而廉价的物品
words.example: Stores really like orange cauliflower because it's a novelty, it's something different.
words.exampleTranslation: 商店真地喜欢橘黄色花椰菜，因为它是一种新奇的东西，与众不同。

words.translation: 占领； 占；vt. 占有
words.example: How much memory does the program occupy?
words.exampleTranslation: 这个程序占用多少内存？

words.translation: 线， 细绳；n. 一串， 一行
words.example: He went off to change a guitar string.
words.exampleTranslation: 他离开了去换一根吉他弦。

words.translation: 激增， 繁荣， 迅速发展；vi. 发出隆隆声；激增，繁荣，迅速发展；n. 隆隆声，嗡嗡声
words.example: He made a small fortune in the property boom.
words.exampleTranslation: 他在房地产繁荣期发了一小笔财。

words.translation: 缺席， 不在； 缺席的时间， 外出期；n. 缺乏， 不存在
words.example: His absence went unremarked.
words.exampleTranslation: 没有人注意到他不在场。

words.translation: vt. 彻底废除， 废止
words.example: These reforms will abolish racially discriminatory laws.
words.exampleTranslation: 这些改革将废除种族歧视法律。

words.translation: vt. 吸引， 引起…注意
words.example: She tried to attract the waiter's attention.
words.exampleTranslation: 她试图引起服务员的注意。

words.translation: adj. 十分小心的， 谨慎的
words.example: They've taken a very cautious approach.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们采取了十分谨慎的态度。

words.translation: vi. 一把抓住；夺，夺走，抢走；一下子拉，一把抓住；vt. 抓住机会做，抽空做；n. 片断
words.example: Hey, you kids! Don't all snatch!
words.exampleTranslation: 嗨，孩子们！别抢啊！

words.translation: 眨眼睛；vi. 闪亮，闪烁；眨眼睛；n. 一瞬间
words.example: He developed a nervous twitch and began to blink constantly.
words.exampleTranslation: 他患上了一种神经痉挛病，开始不停地眨眼睛。

words.translation: 最高点， 峰顶；n. 最高级会议
words.example: We reached the summit at noon.
words.exampleTranslation: 中午时分我们抵达峰顶。

words.translation: n. 香水，香料，香气；使充满芳香；vt. 洒香水于
words.example: She drenched herself in perfume.
words.exampleTranslation: 她浑身洒满香水。

words.translation: 放大， 扩大；vt. 夸大， 夸张
words.example: If you really magnify the spectrum of the sunlight, you could identify more than 100,000 of them.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果你真的放大太阳光的光谱，你可以分辨出多达10万条的光谱线。

words.translation: adj. 多余的， 过剩的
words.example: Changes in technology may mean that once-valued skills are now redundant.
words.exampleTranslation: 技术的变化可能意味着从前受重视的技巧现在变得多余了。

words.translation: 位于…的， 坐落在…的；adj. 处于…境地的
words.example: The hotel is conveniently situated close to the beach.
words.exampleTranslation: 那家旅馆坐落在海滩附近，非常方便。

words.translation: n. 衰退， 衰退期
words.example: The country was mired in recession.
words.exampleTranslation: 这个国家陷入了经济衰退的困境。

words.translation: adv. 无疑地， 肯定地
words.example: He will doubtless try and persuade his colleagues to change their minds.
words.exampleTranslation: 他大概会尽力说服他的同事们改变主意。

words.translation: 否定的，消极的；adj. 负的，阴性的；负片， 底片；n. 负数
words.example: They received a negative reply.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们得到一个否定的答复。

words.translation: 把…强加；vt. 征
words.example: He has tried to impose solutions to the country's problems by fiat.
words.exampleTranslation: 他已经试图采取强制性法令来解决该国的问题。

words.translation: 陈述， 声明；n. 结算单， 报表
words.example: We've got her statement on tape.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们已经把她的陈述录在磁带上了。

words.translation: 商标， 牌号；n. 特征， 标记
words.example: 'Big Mac' is McDonald's best-known trademark.
words.exampleTranslation: “巨无霸”是麦当劳最著名的商标。

words.translation: 因素， 因子；n. 系数
words.example: Lack of cash is a limiting factor.
words.exampleTranslation: 现金短缺是一个制约因素。

words.translation: 类似的， 相似的；adj. 可比拟的
words.example: Leibniz developed closely analogous concepts and techniques.
words.exampleTranslation: 莱布尼茨发展了类似的概念和技术。

words.translation: 物质； 实质； 大意， 要旨；n. 根据， 理由
words.example: Petrol is a volatile substance.
words.exampleTranslation: 汽油是挥发性物质。

words.translation: 肤色， 面色； 局面；n. 性质
words.example: My complexion remained pale and pasty.
words.exampleTranslation: 我的脸色依旧苍白憔悴。

words.translation: n. 连续， 持续
words.example: Natives give it solidity and continuity; but the settlers give it passion.
words.exampleTranslation: 当地人赋予它稳定性和延续性；但是定居者赋予了它激情。

words.translation: 雕刻， 雕塑；n. 雕刻作品， 雕塑品
words.example: He collects modern sculpture.
words.exampleTranslation: 他收藏现代雕塑。

words.translation: n. 靶， 标的， 目标
words.example: She fired an arrow at the target.
words.exampleTranslation: 她瞄准靶子射箭。

words.translation: 动力， 冲力， 势头；n. 动量
words.example: The vehicle gained momentum as the road dipped.
words.exampleTranslation: 那辆车顺着坡越跑冲力越大。

words.translation: n. 蜡，蜂蜡；vt. 给…上蜡
words.example: It was recorded on a wax cylinder.
words.exampleTranslation: 它被刻录在了蜡柱上。

words.translation: 感觉能力； 感觉， 知觉；n. 轰动， 引起轰动的事件
words.example: News of his arrest caused a sensation.
words.exampleTranslation: 他被捕的消息引起了轰动。

words.translation: adj. 都市的， 住在都市的
words.example: Public order is primarily an urban problem.
words.exampleTranslation: 公共秩序主要是一种城市问题。

words.translation: adv. 而且， 此外
words.example: Furthermore, they claim that any such interference is completely ineffective.
words.exampleTranslation: 此外，他们声称任何此类干涉都是完全无效的。

words.translation: adj. 及时的， 适时的
words.example: A nasty incident was prevented by the timely arrival of the police.
words.exampleTranslation: 警察的及时到来阻止了一次严重事故。

words.translation: 斗篷， 披肩；n. 海角， 岬
words.example: I like that part of Cape Town.
words.exampleTranslation: 我喜欢开普敦的那个地方。

words.translation: vt. 丢弃， 抛弃， 遗弃
words.example: Einstein had the chutzpah to discard long-established theory.
words.exampleTranslation: 爱因斯坦拥有抛弃早已既定的理论之胆识。

words.translation: 纤细的； 易碎的； 微妙的；adj. 精美的
words.example: The name Latifah, by the way, means "delicate."
words.exampleTranslation: 顺便提一下，Latifah这个名字有“精致”之意。

words.translation: 反叛， 造反；vi. 反对， 不服从；n. 反叛分子，反对者
words.example: She had been a rebel at school.
words.exampleTranslation: 她在学校时就是个叛逆者。

words.translation: n. 津贴， 补助金
words.example: European farmers are planning a massive demonstration against farm subsidy cuts.
words.exampleTranslation: 欧洲的农场主们正在策划一场反对削减农场补贴的大游行。

words.translation: v. 弹起，反弹，颠跳；n. 弹， 反弹
words.example: There's not much bounce left in these balls.
words.exampleTranslation: 这些球已没有多少弹性了。

words.translation: 淫秽的， 下流的；adj. 可憎的， 可恶的
words.example: Obscene and threatening phone calls are against the law.
words.exampleTranslation: 猥亵电话和恐吓电话是违法的。

words.translation: 组织；n. 薄绢， 薄纸， 手巾纸
words.example: As we age we lose muscle tissue.
words.exampleTranslation: 随着年纪的增大，我们会失去一些肌肉组织。

words.translation: n. 感恩节
words.example: Are you going home for Thanksgiving?
words.exampleTranslation: 你回家过感恩节吗？

words.translation: n. 熟练， 精通
words.example: Evidence of basic proficiency in English is part of the admissions requirement.
words.exampleTranslation: 基本英语水平的证明是录取条件的一部分。

words.translation: 谦虚的； 适中的；adj. 羞怯的
words.example: She's very modest about her success.
words.exampleTranslation: 她对自己的成功非常谦虚。

words.translation: 投，扔，抛；vt. 浇铸；演员表， 全体演员； 石膏绷带； 铸型， 铸件；n. 投， 抛
words.example: The play has a very strong cast.
words.exampleTranslation: 这部剧演员阵容强大。

words.translation: adj. 职业的， 业务的
words.example: He ought to get good vocational training.
words.exampleTranslation: 他应该接受良好的职业培训。

words.translation: vt. 压碎， 碾碎， 镇压
words.example: She had a crush on you, you know.
words.exampleTranslation: 你知道吧，她曾暗恋过你。

words.translation: n. 憎恶， 憎恨， 仇恨
words.example: Often her feelings were nearer hatred than love.
words.exampleTranslation: 她的感情往往更像是恨，而不是爱。

words.translation: n. 薄片，切片，部分；vt. 切， 削， 剁
words.example: Bess stabbed a slice of cucumber.
words.exampleTranslation: 贝斯戳起一片黄瓜。

words.translation: n. 电子
words.example: Magnetic coils focus the electron beams into fine spots.
words.exampleTranslation: 磁线圈将电子束聚焦成细小的点。

words.translation: 把…嵌入， 扎牢；vt. 使深留脑中
words.example: In fact, the process can embed small flaws in the genes of clones that scientists are only now discovering.
words.exampleTranslation: 事实上，这个过程可能会在克隆的基因中嵌入一些小的缺陷，而科学家们直到现在才发现这些缺陷。

words.translation: n. 斜坡[In'klaIn]；vt. 使倾斜
words.example: I incline to the view that we should take no action at this stage.
words.exampleTranslation: 我倾向于认为我们在这个阶段不应采取行动。

words.translation: 提升…的职位， 提高， 改善； 使情绪高昂；vt. 举起， 使上升
words.example: Even better would be to help elevate notions of beauty beyond the material standards of a particular industry.
words.exampleTranslation: 更好的办法是帮助提升美的概念，超越特定行业的物质标准。

words.translation: 指派， 委任； 标出；vt. 把…定名为
words.example: Japan's prime minister-designate is completing his cabinet today.
words.exampleTranslation: 日本即将上任的首相今天将完成他的内阁组建。

words.translation: adj. 有希望的， 有前途的
words.example: He was voted most promising new director.
words.exampleTranslation: 他当选为最有前途的新导演。

words.translation: 圆滑的， 口齿伶俐的； 精巧的， 巧妙的， 灵巧的；adj. 光滑的， 滑溜的
words.example: They are also covered with a slick, transparent lid that reduces drag.
words.exampleTranslation: 它们还覆盖着一层光滑、透明的盖子，可以减少阻力。

words.translation: adj. 可行的， 适用的
words.example: It offers practicable advice to businessmen.
words.exampleTranslation: 它为商人提供切实可行的建议。

words.translation: n. 条， 条款
words.example: This item should be hand washed.
words.exampleTranslation: 这件物品要用手洗。

words.translation: 律师，法律顾问；n. 忠告，劝告；vt. 劝告， 提议
words.example: He had always been able to count on her wise counsel.
words.exampleTranslation: 他总是能够指望她明智的忠告。

words.translation: 帆布；n. 帆布画布， 油画
words.example: He took out a metal flask from a canvas bag.
words.exampleTranslation: 他从帆布袋里拿出了一个金属水瓶。

words.translation: 主管人， 监管人， 负责人；n. 警长
words.example: He became superintendent of the bank's East African branches.
words.exampleTranslation: 他成了这家银行东非分行的主管。

words.translation: 可能性， 可能发生的事；n. 概率
words.example: There seemed to be a high probability of success.
words.exampleTranslation: 成功的几率似乎很高。

words.translation: 论点；n. 争论， 争辩
words.example: One area of contention is the availability of nursery care.
words.exampleTranslation: 争论的一个方面是提供幼儿保育的可能性。

words.translation: 高傲的， 傲慢的； 崇高的， 高尚的；adj. 高耸的， 极高的
words.example: It was a bank that started out with grand ideas and lofty ideals.
words.exampleTranslation: 那是一家创办时带着宏大理念、崇高理想的银行。

words.translation: 详述的， 明确的， 明晰的；adj. 直言的， 露骨的
words.example: He gave me very explicit directions on how to get there.
words.exampleTranslation: 他清楚地向我说明了去那儿的路线。

words.translation: 依靠， 依赖；vi. 信赖， 指望
words.example: It would be rash to rely on such evidence.
words.exampleTranslation: 依靠这样的证据太轻率了。

words.translation: 滑；v. 悄悄地移动；滑动； 滑道， 滑面；n. 幻灯片
words.example: The dollar continued to slide.
words.exampleTranslation: 美元继续下跌。

words.translation: vt. 利用
words.example: Sound engineers utilize a range of techniques to enhance the quality of the recordings.
words.exampleTranslation: 音响工程师利用一系列的技术来提高录音质量。

words.translation: 黏性的， 胶粘的；adj. 湿热的
words.example: The plant exudes a sticky fluid.
words.exampleTranslation: 这种植物分泌出一种黏液。

words.translation: vi. 流行， 盛行
words.example: We hoped that common sense would prevail.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们希望常识能占上风。

words.translation: adj. 过多的， 极度的
words.example: Excessive conformity is usually caused by fear of disapproval.
words.exampleTranslation: 过分随大流通常是由于担心不被认同造成的。

words.translation: 否认；n. 拒绝， 拒绝给予
words.example: Joanna's denial rang true.
words.exampleTranslation: 乔安娜的否认听上去像是真的。

words.translation: n. 攻击， 袭击
words.example: Police were shocked by the viciousness of the assault.
words.exampleTranslation: 警方对这一攻击的残忍感到震惊。

words.translation: 不言明的， 含蓄的； 内含的， 固有的；adj. 无疑问的
words.example: Recent research on consumer memory and judgment suggests another advantage of implicit conclusions.
words.exampleTranslation: 最近关于消费者记忆和判断的研究显示了隐含结论的另一个优势。

words.translation: v. 增强， 加剧
words.example: Failure can never defeat me but only intensify my desire to succeed.
words.exampleTranslation: 失败永远无法打败我，只会增强我对获得成功的渴望。

words.translation: 女性的， 女子的；adj. 女子气的
words.example: The French word for 'table' is feminine.
words.exampleTranslation: 法语的table一词是阴性。

words.translation: n. 纯净， 纯洁， 纯正
words.example: The water is regularly tested for purity.
words.exampleTranslation: 水的纯度定期受到检测。

words.translation: 型，式样；n. 模，模型；vt. 仿制， 使…仿效
words.example: All three attacks followed the same pattern.
words.exampleTranslation: 3次袭击都依照同一模式。

words.translation: 安排， 安放； 调停； 支付， 核算； 安家； 飞落， 停留；v. 安定
words.example: It's time to settle this mano-a-mano.
words.exampleTranslation: 现在是当面解决这个问题的时候了。

words.translation: v. 提高， 加强
words.example: I think what screen dance will do, though, is heighten awareness of dance in general.
words.exampleTranslation: 我认为荧屏舞蹈会在总体上提高人们对舞蹈的认知。

words.translation: 车辆， 机动车；n. 传播媒介， 工具， 手段
words.example: The vehicle was engulfed in flames.
words.exampleTranslation: 汽车被大火吞没。

words.translation: 刮，擦；v. 勉强过日子；刮， 擦；n. 刮擦声
words.example: I might scrape through the exam if I'm lucky.
words.exampleTranslation: 要是走运的话，我也许能勉强及格。

words.translation: 网； 网络；n. 错综复杂的事物
words.example: You need an up-to-date Web browser.
words.exampleTranslation: 你需要一个最新的网络浏览器。

words.translation: n. 女性气质
words.example: I wonder if there isn't a streak of femininity in him, a kind of sweetness.
words.exampleTranslation: 我想知道他身上是否没有一丝女性气质，一种温柔。

words.translation: 高原；n. 稳定时期
words.example: We took a plane southwest across the Anatolian plateau to Cappadocia.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们乘飞机朝西南方,越过安纳托利亚高原,飞往卡帕多细亚。

words.translation: 悲惨的， 可悲的；adj. 悲剧的
words.example: The novel is comic and tragic.
words.exampleTranslation: 这本小说兼有喜剧和悲剧的特点。

words.translation: n. 咧嘴笑
words.example: Mary gave her a sheepish grin.
words.exampleTranslation: 玛丽难为情地冲她咧嘴一笑。

words.translation: 握紧，抓牢；vt. 吸引住…的注意力；n. 紧握
words.example: He kept a tight grip on her arm.
words.exampleTranslation: 他紧紧握住她的胳膊。

words.translation: n. 依靠， 依赖
words.example: People learned self-reliance because they had to.
words.exampleTranslation: 人们学会了自立因为他们不得不这样做。

words.translation: 探险， 探索；v. 仔细查阅， 探究
words.example: We will explore every avenue until we find an answer.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们要探索一切途径，直到找到答案为止。

words.translation: 陈列， 展览；n&vt. 显示
words.example: These statistics display a definite trend.
words.exampleTranslation: 这些统计数据表现出一种明显的趋势。

words.translation: n. 电
words.example: He cannot fix the electricity.
words.exampleTranslation: 他不会修理电路。

words.translation: 气候； 风土， 地带；n. 风气， 气氛
words.example: The economic climate remains uncertain.
words.exampleTranslation: 经济气候依然是不确定。

words.translation: adj. 试探的， 试验的
words.example: We made a tentative arrangement to meet on Friday.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们暂定星期五见面。

words.translation: 混乱， 杂乱；n. 骚乱
words.example: The FDA has approved a new treatment for a rare blood disorder.
words.exampleTranslation: 食品及药物管理局通过了一种罕见血液疾病的新疗法。

words.translation: 加重， 加剧， 使恶化；vt. 激怒， 使恼火
words.example: Pollution can aggravate asthma.
words.exampleTranslation: 污染会使气喘加重。

words.translation: vt. 批评， 评论， 非难
words.example: All you ever do is criticize!
words.exampleTranslation: 你就知道批评！

words.translation: vi. 主持，主管
words.example: They asked if I would preside at the committee meeting.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们问我是否会主持委员会会议。

words.translation: 经济的；adj. 经济学的；经济学；n. 经济状况
words.example: Economic recovery is here.
words.exampleTranslation: 经济复苏现在开始了。

words.translation: n. 晶体管， 晶体管收音机
words.example: This transistor radio has four small cells.
words.exampleTranslation: 这台半导体收音机用4节小电池。

words.translation: 统计学；n. 统计表
words.example: These statistics are misleading.
words.exampleTranslation: 这些统计资料会引起误解。

words.translation: 讨厌的， 糟糕的； 严厉的；adj. 冷酷的， 无情的
words.example: They painted a grim picture of growing crime.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们描绘了一个犯罪增长的严酷局面。

words.translation: n. 咯咯笑， 傻笑
words.example: We only did it for a giggle.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们做那件事只是开个玩笑而已。

words.translation: 子女， 子孙， 后代；n. 崽
words.example: The offspring contain a mixture of the genetic blueprint of each parent.
words.exampleTranslation: 后代体内含有父母亲基因图谱的混合。

words.translation: 逮捕，拘留；停止，阻止；vt. 吸引；n. 逮捕， 拘留， 扣留
words.example: She was kept under close arrest.
words.exampleTranslation: 她被严密监禁。

words.translation: 成熟的，成年人的；深思熟虑的；adj. 到期的，应支付的；vt. 使成熟
words.example: Jane is very mature for her age.
words.exampleTranslation: 简年龄不大，却很成熟。

words.translation: 减轻；vt. 缓解， 缓和
words.example: A number of measures were taken to alleviate the problem.
words.exampleTranslation: 采取了一系列措施缓解这个问题。

words.translation: 通知， 告示；n. 通知书
words.example: Names of the dead and injured are being withheld pending notification of relatives.
words.exampleTranslation: 伤亡者的姓名在通知亲属前不被公布。

words.translation: 满得外溢，外流，泛滥；vi. 充满，洋溢；vt. 淹没， 从…中溢出， 多得无法容纳；容纳不下的物； 溢出， 满出；n. 溢流口， 溢流管
words.example: Pour in some of the broth, but not all of it, because it will probably overflow.
words.exampleTranslation: 倒入部分肉汤，不要全部，因为很可能会溢出来。

words.translation: 对…挑衅， 激怒；vt. 激起， 引起
words.example: His duty was to conciliate the people, not to provoke them.
words.exampleTranslation: 他的任务是安抚这些人，而不是激怒他们。

words.translation: 威胁， 恐吓； 预示快要来临；v. 构成威胁， 可能发生
words.example: We are reproducing ourselves at such a rate that our numbers threaten the ecology of the planet.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们繁衍得如此之快，以至于人口数量威胁到地球的生态系统。

words.translation: 充实， 使丰富；vt. 使富裕， 使富有
words.example: Literature can enrich your spiritual life.
words.exampleTranslation: 文学可以丰富你的精神生活。

words.translation: 箔，金属薄片；n. 陪衬，衬托；vt. 挫败， 使受挫折
words.example: Wrap the meat in foil before you cook it.
words.exampleTranslation: 把肉用锡箔裹起来后再烹调。

words.translation: 扭伤， 拉伤； 尽力使用， 紧张； 拉紧；v. 尽力；拉紧；过劳，极度紧张；张力；扭伤，拉伤；旋律；品种，家系；n. 气质，个性特点
words.example: The rope broke under the strain.
words.exampleTranslation: 绳子给拉断了。

words.translation: 洽谈， 协商， 谈判；v. 顺利通过， 成功越过
words.example: Opposition grew and the government agreed to negotiate.
words.exampleTranslation: 反对势力日益强烈，政府同意进行谈判。

words.translation: 地窖， 地下室；n. 酒窖
words.example: Suddenly she dashed down to the cellar.
words.exampleTranslation: 她猛地朝地窖冲过去。

words.translation: v. 缠结，乱作一团；乱糟糟的一堆， 混乱； 复杂的问题；n. 困惑
words.example: This view has caused great controversy: Black Americans have fallen into a "tangle of pathology".
words.exampleTranslation: 这个观点引发了极大的争议：美国黑人已经深陷一种“病态的混乱”。

words.translation: 包裹，包装；n. 一揽子交易；把…打包；vt. 包装
words.example: I tore the package open.
words.exampleTranslation: 我把包裹撕开。

words.translation: vi. 耍阴谋，施诡计；vt. 激起…的好奇心，迷住；n. 阴谋， 诡计， 密谋
words.example: He found himself snared in a web of intrigue.
words.exampleTranslation: 他发现自己中了圈套。

words.translation: 转向特定方向；vi. 适应[theO-]；使适应，使熟悉情况；vt. 使朝向，以…为方向；n. 东方， 亚洲， 东半球
words.example: It took him some time to orient himself in his new school.
words.exampleTranslation: 他经过了一段时间才熟悉新学校的环境。

words.translation: 危机， 存亡之际；n. 关键阶段
words.example: At home a crisis was brewing.
words.exampleTranslation: 家里一场危机正在酝酿着。

words.translation: 缺陷；n. 障碍，不利条件；vt. 妨碍， 使不利
words.example: Being a foreigner was not a handicap.
words.exampleTranslation: 作一名外国人并不是一个不利条件。

words.translation: 幸存； 幸存者；n. 残存物
words.example: It was a matter of simple survival.
words.exampleTranslation: 这完全是能不能生存的问题。

words.translation: vi. 碎裂；使粉碎，砸碎；使破灭；vt. 使震惊
words.example: A failure would shatter the hopes of many people.
words.exampleTranslation: 一次失败会粉碎很多人的希望。

words.translation: 恳求， 请求； 抗辩， 答辩， 辩护；n. 借口， 托辞
words.example: He reached a plea bargain with the authorities.
words.exampleTranslation: 他和当局达成了辩诉交易。

words.translation: 说服， 劝说；n. 信念， 信仰
words.example: He had to use all his powers of persuasion.
words.exampleTranslation: 他只好使出说服人的全部本领。

words.translation: 热心的； 激烈的；adj. 敏锐的， 敏捷的
words.example: John was very keen to help.
words.exampleTranslation: 约翰很热心，愿意帮忙。

words.translation: n. 营养
words.example: There are alternative sources of nutrition to animal meat.
words.exampleTranslation: 有能替代动物肉类的其他营养来源。

words.translation: n. 侦探， 私人侦探
words.example: He plays a wisecracking detective.
words.exampleTranslation: 他扮演一位满嘴俏皮话的侦探。

words.translation: 搬， 转移； 调动， 转学； 转让， 过户；v. 乘车， 转乘
words.example: The novel does not transfer well to the movies.
words.exampleTranslation: 这部小说不太适宜改编成电影。

words.translation: adj. 经验丰富的；老手；n. 老兵
words.example: He is a veteran parliamentarian whose views enjoy widespread respect.
words.exampleTranslation: 他是一位资深议员，其观点受到广泛尊重。

words.translation: 加工而成的谷类食物；n. 谷类植物， 谷物
words.example: He ate a large bowlful of cereal.
words.exampleTranslation: 他吃了一大碗谷类早餐。

words.translation: 美学的， 审美的；adj. 悦目的， 雅致的
words.example: Only is has in one whole esthetic sense.
words.exampleTranslation: 只是有着一种整体上的美感。

words.translation: 冷漠的， 不积极的；adj. 一般的， 平平的
words.example: He was mute, distant, and indifferent.
words.exampleTranslation: 他缄默无言，对人疏远而且冷漠。

words.translation: 感情；n. 爱， 爱慕
words.example: I still have affection for my old school.
words.exampleTranslation: 我对母校依然很有感情。

words.translation: 转移， 转向； 消遣， 娱乐；n. 临时绕行路
words.example: The party will make a pleasant diversion.
words.exampleTranslation: 晚会会是一个很不错的消遣。

words.translation: adj. 基本的， 初级的
words.example: Literacy now includes elementary computer skills.
words.exampleTranslation: 有文化现在包括基本的计算机技能。

words.translation: n. 鹰
words.example: An eagle circled high overhead.
words.exampleTranslation: 一只鹰在头顶上空盘旋。

words.translation: 庄严的， 隆重的；adj. 严肃的
words.example: I made a solemn promise that I would return.
words.exampleTranslation: 我郑重承诺我会回来的。

words.translation: vt. 使窘迫， 使为难
words.example: I didn't want to embarrass him by kissing him in front of his friends.
words.exampleTranslation: 我并没想当着他的朋友吻他而使他感到难堪。

words.translation: adj. 错误的， 不正确的
words.example: Some people have the erroneous notion that one can contract AIDS by giving blood.
words.exampleTranslation: 有些人有这样一种错误的观念：认为献血会染上艾滋病。

words.translation: 选择， 选择权， 选择自由；n. 选择的事物， 选课
words.example: A luggage rack is a sensible option.
words.exampleTranslation: 行李架是个明智的选择。

words.translation: 严重的； 急性的； 灵敏的， 敏锐的；adj. 精明的
words.example: There is an acute shortage of water.
words.exampleTranslation: 水严重短缺。

words.translation: 限制， 限度；n. 局限
words.example: They would resist any limitation of their powers.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们会抵制对他们权力的任何限制。

words.translation: 慢跑；n&v. 轻轻碰撞
words.example: I got up early the next morning to jog.
words.exampleTranslation: 我次日清晨早起去慢跑了。

words.translation: vt. 使害怕， 使惊吓
words.example: Their movements through the region were calculated to terrify landowners into abandoning their holdings.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们在整个地区的行动意在恐吓地主们放弃其财产。

words.translation: n. 手册， 便览
words.example: She is reading a handbook on gardening.
words.exampleTranslation: 她正在阅读一本园艺手册。

words.translation: 弄清， 查明；vt. 确定
words.example: It can be difficult to ascertain the facts.
words.exampleTranslation: 可能难以查明事实真相。

words.translation: adj. 至关重要的， 决定性的
words.example: Defence of the realm is crucial.
words.exampleTranslation: 王国的防御是至关重要的。

words.translation: 捐献， 捐款；v. 投稿
words.example: Do you wish to contribute?
words.exampleTranslation: 你想捐助吗？

words.translation: 插入， 嵌入；vt. 登载
words.example: Open any of the layout templates, insert your text, make any other changes, and print.
words.exampleTranslation: 打开任何一个设计模板，插入你的文本，做任何其他改动，然后打印。

words.translation: 信任， 信心；n. 信仰， 信条
words.example: Faith is stronger than reason.
words.exampleTranslation: 信仰比理智更有力。

words.translation: 灵感；n. 鼓舞人心的人
words.example: Both poets drew their inspiration from the countryside.
words.exampleTranslation: 两位诗人都是从乡村得到他们的灵感。

words.translation: 忍耐力；n. 持久， 耐久
words.example: He showed remarkable endurance throughout his illness.
words.exampleTranslation: 他在整个生病期间表现出非凡的忍耐力。

words.translation: vt. 强调，突出，使显著；n. 最精彩的部分， 最重要的事件
words.example: The surveyor's report didn't highlight anything untoward.
words.exampleTranslation: 测量员的报告没有强调有出乎意料的困难。

words.translation: n. 候选人， 投考者， 申请求职者
words.example: Neither candidate won outright.
words.exampleTranslation: 两个候选人谁也没干脆利落地获胜。

words.translation: vi. 努力， 奋斗， 力求
words.example: Newspaper editors all strive to be first with a story.
words.exampleTranslation: 报纸编辑都力争率先报道。

words.translation: n. 数据库
words.example: The system came with a database software package.
words.exampleTranslation: 本系统配有数据库软件包。

words.translation: adj. 可理解的， 明白易懂的， 清楚的
words.example: His lecture was readily intelligible to all the students.
words.exampleTranslation: 他的讲课学生们都能轻松地听懂。

words.translation: 并列的，平行的；类似的；对应的；adj. 并联的；可相比拟的事物，相似处；平行线，平行面；n. 纬线；vt. 与…相似， 与… 相当， 比得上
words.example: The road runs parallel to the river.
words.exampleTranslation: 这条路和这条河是平行的。

words.translation: 拒绝；vt. 拒纳， 退回， 摈弃；n. 被拒货品， 不合格产品
words.example: Animals reject the runt of the litter.
words.exampleTranslation: 动物们排斥一窝中最弱小的幼仔。

words.translation: n. 友好款待， 好客
words.example: Their hospitality is proverbial.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们的热情好客人人皆知。

words.translation: adv. 垂直地，陡峭地；vi. 急转向， 偏离；完全的，十足的；陡峭的，垂直的；adj. 极薄的，透明的
words.example: The concert was sheer delight.
words.exampleTranslation: 这场音乐会是一次十足的享受。

words.translation: 模仿； 仿制， 伪制品；n. 赝品
words.example: A child learns to talk by imitation.
words.exampleTranslation: 小孩子通过模仿学会说话。

words.translation: 赞美，恭维；n. 致意，问候；vt. 赞美， 恭维
words.example: Don't be upset—I'm sure she meant it as a compliment.
words.exampleTranslation: 别烦恼—我肯定她的原意是要称赞你的。

words.translation: 跌跌撞撞地走， 慌乱地走；vi. 犯错误；n. 错误
words.example: It had been a monumental blunder to give him the assignment.
words.exampleTranslation: 分配给他这项任务是一个巨大的错误。

words.translation: 破坏，违反；破裂，不和；n. 缺口，裂口；攻破， 在…造成缺口；vt. 破坏， 违反
words.example: They escaped through a breach in the wire fence.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们从铁丝网上的一个缺口逃走了。

words.translation: 最初的；新颖的；adj. 原版的；n. 原件， 原作
words.example: The original station opened in 1954.
words.exampleTranslation: 原来的车站是1954年启用的。

words.translation: vi. 遵从， 依从， 服从
words.example: She must be made to comply with the rules.
words.exampleTranslation: 必须让她遵守规则。

words.translation: vi. 背离， 偏离
words.example: Should the use of rewards fail, members can frequently win by rejecting or threatening to ostracize those who deviate from the primary group's norms.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果使用奖励失败了，通过拒绝或威胁来排斥那些偏离主要群体规范的人，成员可以经常获胜。

words.translation: 任务； 指定的作业；n. 分配， 指派
words.example: I had set myself a tough assignment.
words.exampleTranslation: 我给自己定了一项艰巨任务。

words.translation: n. 粘贴簿， 集邮簿， 相册
words.example: Their new album is dynamite.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们的新唱片引起轰动。

words.translation: 促进；n. 刺激
words.example: For many firms, they are a stimulus to revenue.
words.exampleTranslation: 对许多公司来说，它们是刺激收入的因素。

words.translation: adj. 电的， 电动的
words.example: The electric will be off tomorrow.
words.exampleTranslation: 明天停电。

words.translation: 使迷惑；vt. 使难住
words.example: So many questions bewilder me.
words.exampleTranslation: 这样多的问题使我困惑。

words.translation: 团；n. 大量；vt. 严格地管制， 严密地编组
words.example: We were part of an entire regiment that had nothing else to do but to keep that motorway open.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们是整个团的一部分，这个团无其他任务,只是保证公路畅通。

words.translation: vi. 变少，变小，降低；vt. 减少， 减小， 降低
words.example: Deserts in sub-Saharan Africa will diminish gradually.
words.exampleTranslation: 撒哈拉以南非洲的沙漠将逐渐减少。

words.translation: 超过， 优于， 多于；vt. 超过…的界限， 非…所能办到
words.example: He was determined to surpass the achievements of his older brothers.
words.exampleTranslation: 他决心超过他的几位哥哥的成就。

words.translation: adj. 各种各样的， 不同的
words.example: He directed various TV shows.
words.exampleTranslation: 他导演过各种电视节目。

words.translation: 抑郁， 沮丧； 不景气， 萧条；n. 洼地， 凹陷
words.example: She had slid into a depression.
words.exampleTranslation: 她不知不觉地抑郁寡欢起来。

words.translation: vt. 使隶属于；n. 附属机构， 分公司
words.example: Sometimes the registration tracking to AA can be overwritten if you click to another affiliate, though I've always received both the rebate and the miles.
words.exampleTranslation: 有时如果你点击到另一个分支机构的话，AA 上的注册信息会重复。不过，通常我都会既收到回馈，又得到里程奖励。

words.translation: 展开， 打开；v. 显露， 展现
words.example: I begin to unfold myself.
words.exampleTranslation: 我开始展开自己。

words.translation: 广度； 范围；n. 程度
words.example: That's true, to a certain extent.
words.exampleTranslation: 在一定程度上的确如此。

words.translation: adj. 相等的，等量的；n. 相等物， 等价物
words.example: Zip disks could be used to store the equivalent of three music CDs.
words.exampleTranslation: 压缩盘能用以存储相当于3张音乐CD容量的内容。

words.translation: 轰动的， 耸人听闻的；adj. 使人感动的， 非常好的
words.example: The result was a sensational 4–1 victory.
words.exampleTranslation: 比赛结果是轰动性的，以4:1狂胜对手。

words.translation: n. 楔；vt. 楔入， 塞入
words.example: He hammered the wedge into the crack in the stone.
words.exampleTranslation: 他用锤子把楔子砸入石缝里。

words.translation: 使疏远， 使不友好， 离间；vt. 转让， 让渡
words.example: His second wife, Alice, was determined to alienate him from his two boys.
words.exampleTranslation: 他的第2个妻子阿丽丝决心让他疏远他的两个儿子。

words.translation: n. 边缘， 边沿
words.example: The church seems to be on the brink of schism.
words.exampleTranslation: 该教会看来处于分裂的边缘。

words.translation: 瘟疫，鼠疫；n. 灾难，祸患；vt. 使痛苦， 给…造成困难
words.example: It delves into everything from seasickness, jet lag and the hazards of camels to malaria and plague.
words.exampleTranslation: 它探究了从晕船、时差和骆驼的危害到疟疾和瘟疫的一切。

words.translation: 永久的， 永恒的， 长期的；adj. 无休止的， 没完没了的
words.example: The perpetual argument is that funds are tight, that we have more pressing problems here on Earth.
words.exampleTranslation: 永恒的争论是资金紧张，我们在地球上有更紧迫的问题。

words.translation: n. 回顾
words.example: The decision seems extremely odd, in retrospect.
words.exampleTranslation: 回想起来，这个决定显得极其荒谬。

words.translation: vt. 强烈地吸引， 迷住
words.example: Angels fascinate, as Christmas-card-makers rediscover every year.
words.exampleTranslation: 天使令人着迷，正如圣诞卡制造商们每年一再发现的那样。

words.translation: adj. 殖民地的
words.example: His guerrillas defeated the colonial army in 1954.
words.exampleTranslation: 他的游击队在1954年打败了殖民军。

words.translation: 战争；n. 斗争， 冲突
words.example: These clashes could develop into open warfare.
words.exampleTranslation: 这些冲突可能会发展成公开的战争。

words.translation: 草稿；汇票；征兵；n. 通风；起草；vt. 征募
words.example: I've made a rough draft of the letter.
words.exampleTranslation: 我已经写好这封信的草稿。

words.translation: 由许多部分组成的，复合的；adj. 复杂的，难懂的；综合体， 集合体；n. 情结， 夸大的情绪反应
words.example: He was an unusually complex man.
words.exampleTranslation: 他是个异常复杂的人。

words.translation: 假定， 臆断；n. 担任， 承担
words.example: His actions were based on a false assumption.
words.exampleTranslation: 他的行为基于错误的设想。

words.translation: n. 湿度， 潮湿， 湿气
words.example: The humidity is relatively low.
words.exampleTranslation: 湿度相对较低。

words.translation: vi. 列入， 占特定等级；军衔，职衔；地位，社会阶层；n. 排，行列；vt. 把…分等，给…评定等级
words.example: He was soon promoted to the rank of captain.
words.exampleTranslation: 他很快被提升至上尉军阶。

words.translation: n. 小册子
words.example: Madame Blavatsky wrote a pamphlet against phallicism.
words.exampleTranslation: 布拉瓦夫人写了一本关于反对男性生殖器崇拜的册子。

words.translation: adj. 预备的
words.example: The preparatory work for the conference had been undertaken at two meetings of experts.
words.exampleTranslation: 在两次专家会谈中，人们已经着手了会议的筹备工作。

words.translation: 忽视， 忽略；n&vt. 疏忽
words.example: We often neglect to make proper use of our bodies.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们经常疏忽了合理使用我们的身体。

words.translation: 加， 加法；n. 附加物
words.example: There is, in addition, one further point to make.
words.exampleTranslation: 此外，还有一点要说。

words.translation: 静脉， 血管； 叶脉； 纹理， 纹路；n. 方式， 风格
words.example: A tiny wire is threaded through a vein to the heart.
words.exampleTranslation: 一根细金属丝从静脉里穿到心脏。

words.translation: 切， 把…切碎；vt. 雕刻， 刻
words.example: They began to carve separate letters.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们开始雕刻独立的字母。

words.translation: 面纱，面罩；n. 遮盖物，掩饰物；vt. 掩盖， 掩饰
words.example: She put on a velvet veil, then set out.
words.exampleTranslation: 她蒙上一块天鹅绒的面纱，然后出发了。

words.translation: 起皱； 收缩；vi. 退缩， 畏缩
words.example: I've seen a shrink already.
words.exampleTranslation: 我已经看过了精神病医生。

words.translation: 等级制度；n. 统治集团， 领导层
words.example: Like most other American companies with a rigid hierarchy, workers and managers had strictly defined duties.
words.exampleTranslation: 像大多数其他等级制度森严的美国公司一样，工人和管理人员都有严格界定的职责。

words.translation: 祖宗， 祖先； 原型；n. 先驱
words.example: Her Chinese friends referred to the empress as their venerable ancestor.
words.exampleTranslation: 她的中国朋友们称那位皇后是令他们尊敬的祖先。

words.translation: 危险的；adj. 冒险的
words.example: They were incinerating hazardous waste without a licence.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们没有许可就把危险废弃物烧成灰烬。

words.translation: n. 地区， 地点
words.example: There is no airport in the locality.
words.exampleTranslation: 这个地区没有飞机场。

words.translation: n. 诉讼
words.example: Work is proceeding slowly.
words.exampleTranslation: 工作进展缓慢。

words.translation: 动脉；n. 干线， 要道
words.example: He had an operation last year to widen a heart artery.
words.exampleTranslation: 他去年动了一次扩张心脏动脉的手术。

words.translation: v. 恐慌， 惊慌失措；n. 恐慌，惊慌，慌乱
words.example: He willed himself not to panic.
words.exampleTranslation: 他竭力让自己不要恐慌。

words.translation: vt. 对…估计不足，低估；n. 估计不足， 低估
words.example: We often underestimate our potentialities.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们常常低估自己的潜力。

words.translation: vt. 折叠，合拢；n. 褶， 折叠的部分
words.example: You'd better fold it carefully.
words.exampleTranslation: 你最好仔细地折叠好它。

words.translation: 短暂的， 转瞬即逝的；adj. 临时的， 暂住的
words.example: The studies discussed so far exposed people to noise for only short periods and only transient effects were studied.
words.exampleTranslation: "到目前为止所讨论的研究中，人们只是短时间的暴露在噪音中，而且研究的只是短暂的影响。

words.translation: 猛投， 狠掷；vt. 大声叫骂
words.example: It took only one heave to hurl him into the river.
words.exampleTranslation: 只是一推，就把他推进了河里。

words.translation: 竞争的， 比赛的； 好竞争的， 求胜心切的；adj. 有竞争力的
words.example: It's hard to maintain competitive pricing.
words.exampleTranslation: 很难保持有竞争力的定价。

words.translation: 教长， 主任牧师；n. 学院院长， 系主任， 训导主任
words.example: I have tremendous respect for Dean.
words.exampleTranslation: 我非常敬重迪安。

words.translation: 用湿海绵擦， 揩；v. 过寄生生活；n. 海绵
words.example: He wiped off the table with a sponge.
words.exampleTranslation: 他用一块海绵擦了桌子。

words.translation: 滥用； 虐待；vt. 辱骂， 毁谤；滥用； 虐待；n. 辱骂
words.example: Rival fans hurled abuse at each other.
words.exampleTranslation: 两帮对立的球迷相互高声辱骂。

words.translation: v. 密谋， 策划；计划，方案；n. 阴谋
words.example: We devised a scheme to help him.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们想出了一个计划来帮助他。

words.translation: 使绝缘， 使隔热， 使隔音；vt. 隔离， 使隔绝
words.example: Huxley speculated that a coat of hair would insulate against loss of body heat and might streamline the body to reduce drag in flight.
words.exampleTranslation: 赫胥黎推测，一层毛发可以隔离身体热量的流失，并可能使身体呈现流线型，以减少飞行中的阻力。

words.translation: adv. 因此， 因而， 所以
words.example: They had children and were consequently tied to the school vacations.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们有几个孩子，因此被学校假期束缚住了。

words.translation: vi. 慢慢减少；排去，放水；vt. 渐渐耗尽；耗竭；n. 排水沟， 排水管
words.example: The main drain was blocked.
words.exampleTranslation: 主下水道被堵住了。

words.translation: n. 不愿， 勉强
words.example: They finally agreed to our terms with a certain reluctance.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们最终有点勉强地同意了我们的条件。

words.translation: n&vt. 强奸
words.example: Rape is sexualized violence.
words.exampleTranslation: 强奸是性暴力行为。

words.translation: vt. 使隔离， 使孤立
words.example: Researchers are still trying to isolate the gene that causes this abnormality.
words.exampleTranslation: 研究人员仍然在试图分离导致这种畸形的基因。

words.translation: 普及， 流行；n. 声望
words.example: His popularity has slipped recently.
words.exampleTranslation: 近来他已不如过去那样受欢迎。

words.translation: n. 绰号，诨名；vt. 给…起绰号
words.example: She professed to hate her nickname.
words.exampleTranslation: 她声称讨厌她的绰号。

words.translation: adj. 随后的， 后来的
words.example: Subsequent events confirmed our doubts.
words.exampleTranslation: 后来发生的事证实了我们的怀疑。

words.translation: adj. 代谢作用的， 新陈代谢的
words.example: People who have inherited a low metabolic rate will gain weight.
words.exampleTranslation: 因遗传而新陈代谢速度慢的人会发胖。

words.translation: 人类， 人； 人性； 人道， 博爱；n. 人文学科
words.example: It helps engender a sense of common humanity.
words.exampleTranslation: 它有助于引发一种共同的人道主义精神。

words.translation: 新方法， 新事物；n. 革新， 创新
words.example: His greatest innovation was the use of interchangeable parts.
words.exampleTranslation: 他最伟大的创新是使用了可互换部件。

words.translation: vi. 乱扔废弃物；vt. 乱扔东西；废弃物， 被胡乱扔掉的东西； 一窝；n. 杂乱的东西
words.example: Animals reject the runt of the litter.
words.exampleTranslation: 动物们排斥一窝中最弱小的幼仔。

words.translation: 索价；控告；使充电，使充满；v. 向前冲；费用； 管理； 控告， 指责；n. 电荷， 充电
words.example: We can charge $50 a pop.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们可以每个收费50元。

words.translation: 百叶窗；n. 快门
words.example: There are a few things you should check before pressing the shutter release.
words.exampleTranslation: 在按快门之前，有几件事情你应该检查。

words.translation: 交替的， 轮流的；adj. 间隔的；v. 轮流， 交替
words.example: Dark stripes alternate with pale ones.
words.exampleTranslation: 深浅条纹相间。

words.translation: n. 传记
words.example: This book is a well balanced biography.
words.exampleTranslation: 这是一本很公正的传记。

words.translation: 程序； 手续；n. 步骤
words.example: The next day I repeated the procedure.
words.exampleTranslation: 第二天我重复了这个程序。

words.translation: n. 样品，试样，样本；从…抽样；vt. 品尝， 体验
words.example: A routine DNA sample was taken.
words.exampleTranslation: 采集了一份常规的脱氧核糖核酸样本。

words.translation: n&v. 纵身投入， 猛冲， 猛跌
words.example: His weight began to plunge.
words.exampleTranslation: 他的体重开始骤然下降。

words.translation: adj. 表示怀疑的
words.example: If you're still skeptical about exercising, we can only ask you to trust us and give it a try.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果你仍对锻炼持怀疑态度，我们只能请你相信我们，试一试。

words.translation: adj. 紫外的
words.example: Exposure to ultraviolet light is closely linked to skin cancer.
words.exampleTranslation: 受紫外线照射与皮肤癌紧密相关。

words.translation: n. 行星的
words.example: Within our own galaxy there are probably tens of thousands of planetary systems.
words.exampleTranslation: 在我们所在的银河系中，很可能存在数以万计的行星系。

words.translation: n. 签证
words.example: Do you need a visa for the USA?
words.exampleTranslation: 你需要美国签证吗？

words.translation: 诊断；vt. 判断
words.example: The test is used to diagnose a variety of diseases.
words.exampleTranslation: 此项化验可用于诊断多种疾病。

words.translation: v. 请愿， 正式请求；请愿书，申请书；n. 诉状
words.example: Jill volunteered to organize a petition.
words.exampleTranslation: 吉尔自告奋勇组织请愿。

words.translation: n. 周围地区， 邻近地区
words.example: There is no hospital in the immediate vicinity.
words.exampleTranslation: 附近没有医院。

words.translation: 幼稚的； 天真的；adj. 轻信的
words.example: Their approach to life is refreshingly naive.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们对待生活的态度天真率直，令人耳目一新。

words.translation: adj. 必要的，本质的；要素；n. 必需品
words.example: Money is not essential to happiness.
words.exampleTranslation: 金钱对于幸福并非必不可少。

words.translation: 经费， 支出额；n. 花费， 支出， 消耗
words.example: He is rigorous in his control of expenditure.
words.exampleTranslation: 他在控制开支方面一丝不苟。

words.translation: 通风口，排放口；n. 开衩；vt. 表达， 发泄
words.example: She gave vent to her anger and jealousy.
words.exampleTranslation: 她发泄了自己的怒意和嫉妒。

words.translation: 常出没于；使苦恼，使担忧；vt. 萦绕在心头，缠绕；n. 常去的地方
words.example: The Wanglang Preserve in western Sichuan is the haunt of the giant panda.
words.exampleTranslation: 川西的王朗自然保护区是大熊猫出没的地方。

words.translation: vt. 在…之前， 先于
words.example: He gestured to Alice to precede them from the room.
words.exampleTranslation: 他示意艾丽斯从房间里出来走在他们前面。

words.translation: vi. 喘气，倒抽气；vt. 喘着气说出；n. 喘气， 倒抽气
words.example: At last, I hear a soft thud, a gasp, and silence.
words.exampleTranslation: 最后，我听到轻轻的砰的一声，一声喘息，然后是一片寂静。

words.translation: n&vi. 散步， 闲逛
words.example: We went for a stroll in the park.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们去公园散了散步。

words.translation: 供应， 提供；vt. 装备
words.example: They'll be able to furnish you with the rest of the details.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们将能够给你提供其余的细节。

words.translation: vi. 区分，区别；区分， 区别；vt. 使不同， 使有差异
words.example: I can't differentiate one variety from another.
words.exampleTranslation: 我无法将这几个品种区别开来。

words.translation: n. 接触，联系，交往；vt. 与…接触， 与…取得联系
words.example: I will contact you by letter.
words.exampleTranslation: 我会给你写信联系的。

words.translation: n. 衣服
words.example: This garment must be dry-cleaned only.
words.exampleTranslation: 这件衣服只可干洗。

words.translation: 释放，排出；v. 卸货；n. 释放， 放电
words.example: He was given a conditional discharge and ordered to pay Miss Smith $500 compensation.
words.exampleTranslation: 他被判有条件释放，并被命令向史密斯小姐支付$500的赔偿金。

words.translation: vt. 把…排除在外
words.example: She gets very upset if I exclude her from anything.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果有什么事我将她排除在外，她就会非常难过。

words.translation: 可怕的， 骇人的； 惊慌的， 害怕的；adj. 胆小的， 易受惊的
words.example: It was a really scary moment.
words.exampleTranslation: 那一刻真是吓人。

words.translation: 批评， 批判；n. 评论， 评论文章
words.example: He shrugged off the criticism.
words.exampleTranslation: 他对批评不予理睬。

words.translation: vt. 启发， 开导
words.example: It was an elite that believed its task was to enlighten the multitude.
words.exampleTranslation: 精英人物都会认为自己的职责就是启迪群众。

words.translation: adj. 最远的；n. 极限
words.example: Our resources are strained to the utmost.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们的资源极端紧缺。

words.translation: 预期的； 未来的；adj. 可能的
words.example: A prospective premium of about 30 percent on their initial investment is enticing.
words.exampleTranslation: 初始投资30％左右的预期收益是诱人的。

words.translation: v. 减去， 扣除
words.example: In special cases, a husband can deduct the travel expenses of his wife who accompanies him on a business trip.
words.exampleTranslation: 在特殊情况下，丈夫可以扣除差旅中随行妻子的旅费。

words.translation: 灰浆，灰泥；石膏；n. 橡皮膏，膏药；vt. 在…上抹灰泥， 厚厚地涂抹
words.example: One of the kids was peeling plaster off the wall.
words.exampleTranslation: 其中一个孩子在剥墙上的灰泥。

words.translation: 顾问；n. 顾问服务公司
words.example: A survey of 57 hospitals by Newchurch, a consultancy, reveals striking improvements.
words.exampleTranslation: 纽彻奇咨询公司对57家医院的调查显示明显的改善。

words.translation: 大都市的， 大都会的；adj. 首都的
words.example: Two years ago, he signed over his art collection to the New York Metropolitan Museum of Art.
words.exampleTranslation: 两年前，他签字把他的艺术收藏品转让给了纽约大都会艺术博物馆。

words.translation: 描写， 描绘；vt. 扮演， 饰演
words.example: He has worked hard in recent months to portray New York in a better light.
words.exampleTranslation: 最近几个月他一直努力工作要从一个更好的角度描绘纽约。

words.translation: 垃圾， 废物； 废话；n. 无用的资料
words.example: Dig a pit and bury the garbage.
words.exampleTranslation: 挖一个坑把垃圾埋掉。

words.translation: 猜疑的， 疑心的； 可疑的；adj. 表示怀疑的
words.example: I'm suspicious of his motives.
words.exampleTranslation: 我怀疑他的动机。

words.translation: 用力擦洗，把…擦净；v. 取消；n. 矮树丛， 灌木丛
words.example: I started to scrub off the dirt.
words.exampleTranslation: 我开始擦除灰尘。

words.translation: 抱怨， 诉苦；vi. 控告， 投诉
words.example: I was too cowardly to complain.
words.exampleTranslation: 我胆小得都不敢抱怨。

words.translation: adj. 同种类的， 同性质的， 有相同特征的
words.example: Audiences are smaller and more homogeneous than they have been in the past.
words.exampleTranslation: 受众规模比过去更小、更同质。

words.translation: 断言， 坚持声称；vt. 证实， 确认
words.example: I can affirm that no one will lose their job.
words.exampleTranslation: 我可以肯定，谁都不会丢掉工作。

words.translation: 深度的， 深切的， 深远的； 知识渊博的， 见解深刻的；adj. 深奥的
words.example: Her speech made a profound impact on everyone.
words.exampleTranslation: 她的讲话对每个人都有深远的影响。

words.translation: 大理石； 弹子；n. 弹子游戏
words.example: She was chiselling some marble.
words.exampleTranslation: 她在雕刻一些大理石。

words.translation: 焦虑， 忧虑；n. 渴望， 热望
words.example: Her voice was full of anxiety.
words.exampleTranslation: 她的声音饱含焦虑。

words.translation: vi. 适应；调整，调节；vt. 校正
words.example: How did you adjust to college life?
words.exampleTranslation: 你是怎么适应大学生活的？

words.translation: 强烈的愿望；n. 志向， 抱负
words.example: There is also a place in a young life for noble purposes that include a dedication to the broader society, a love of country and an aspiration to make their own leadership contributions.
words.exampleTranslation: 在年轻人的生活中，也有崇高的目标，包括为更广大的社会作出奉献、热爱国家，以及成为领导者做出贡献的抱负。

words.translation: 朝气蓬勃的；adj. 有力的， 用力的
words.example: She was a very vigorous sort of person.
words.exampleTranslation: 她是那种精力非常旺盛的人。

words.translation: 喜欢畅所欲言的，直言不讳的；adj. 嗓音的，发声的；n. 声乐节目
words.example: She loved singing as a child and started vocal training at 12.
words.exampleTranslation: 她还是个小孩的时候就爱唱歌，12岁就开始了声乐训练。

words.translation: vt. 认为， 视为
words.example: They deem travel an important part of their life.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们认为旅行是他们生活中重要的一部分。

words.translation: 起源， 起因；n. 出身， 血统
words.example: The origin of the custom is obscure.
words.exampleTranslation: 该习俗的起源鲜为人知。

words.translation: 发生冲突；不协调；vi. 砰地相撞，发出刺耳的撞击声；冲突； 不协调；n. 刺耳的撞击声
words.example: The only victors in a head-on clash between the president and the assembly would be the hardliners on both sides.
words.exampleTranslation: 总统与议会间正面冲突的惟一赢家将是双方的强硬派。

words.translation: vi. 倾覆， 翻转， 翻倒；使翻转，使倾覆，使倒下；vt. 颠覆，推翻
words.example: Recent evidence of subtle interactions between earthquakes may overturn this assumption, however.
words.exampleTranslation: 然而，最近有关地震之间微妙的相互作用的证据可能会推翻这一假设。

words.translation: vt. 强迫， 迫使屈服
words.example: She could compel him to support the child after it was born.
words.exampleTranslation: 她可以迫使他在孩子出生后抚养孩子。

words.translation: 使沮丧， 使不景气；vt. 按下
words.example: Subsidies allow growers to undercut competitors and depress world prices.
words.exampleTranslation: 补贴使得种植者能以低于竞争对手的价格出售并压低世界价格。

words.translation: adj. 有能力的， 有才能的

words.exampleTranslation: 所以即使在正常条件下，这些亚物种间的基因流动也更像是一条断断续续的细流，而不是一条不停流淌的小溪。

words.translation: 义愤，愤慨；n. 暴行，骇人听闻的事件；vt. 激起…的义愤， 激怒
words.example: Environmentalists have expressed outrage at the ruling.
words.exampleTranslation: 环境保护主义者对这一裁决表示愤慨。

words.translation: 单独的， 独自的； 单个的， 唯一的；adj. 孤独的， 隐居的
words.example: Tigers are solitary animals.
words.exampleTranslation: 虎是独居动物。

words.translation: 扩散， 弥漫；v. 传播， 散布；冗长的， 漫无边际的；adj. 四散的， 弥漫的
words.example: It allows nicotine to diffuse slowly and steadily into the bloodstream.
words.exampleTranslation: 它使尼古丁缓慢、稳步地扩散到血液当中。

words.translation: 攀登，爬；vi. 争夺，抢夺；vt. 扰乱，搞乱；攀登， 爬行；n. 争夺， 抢夺
words.example: There was an undignified scramble for the best seats.
words.exampleTranslation: 大家争抢最好的位子，真是有失体统。

words.translation: n. 管弦乐队
words.example: The orchestra has grown in stature.
words.exampleTranslation: 这支管弦乐队的声望有所提高。

words.translation: 使浸没；vt. 使沉浸在， 使专心于
words.example: Their commitments do not permit them to immerse themselves in current affairs as fully as they might wish.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们的职责不允许他们如其所愿地埋头于时事。

words.translation: adj. 足够的， 充分的
words.example: Is it available in sufficient quantity?
words.exampleTranslation: 这东西能不能足量供应？

words.translation: 元帅，最高指挥官；总指挥，司仪；n. 执法官，警察局长，消防队长；vt. 整理， 排列， 集结
words.example: Air Chief Marshal Glenn Torpy told the graduates, "This is probably one of the most significant milestones in an aviator's career."
words.exampleTranslation: 空军上将 Marshal Glenn Torpy 告诉毕业生，“这可能是飞行员职业生涯中最重要的里程碑之一。”

words.translation: n. 香槟酒
words.example: Champagne sprayed everywhere.
words.exampleTranslation: 香槟酒喷得到处都是。

words.translation: 声称，主张；对…提出要求，索取；使失踪或死亡；vt. 需要，值得；要求； 认领； 索赔；n. 声称， 断言
words.example: The judge allowed my claim.
words.exampleTranslation: 法官同意我的要求。

words.translation: adj. 分布广泛的， 普遍的
words.example: Price gouging is widespread.
words.exampleTranslation: 漫天要价的情况普遍存在。

words.translation: adj. 古时的，古老的；n. 古物， 古玩， 古董
words.example: This isn't a genuine antique—you've been done.
words.exampleTranslation: 这不是真正的古董—你上当了。

words.translation: 通讯， 交流， 交际；n. 通信工具， 交通联系
words.example: Good communication is key to our success.
words.exampleTranslation: 良好的沟通是我们成功的关键。

words.translation: 慢性的， 久病的； 长久的， 不断的；adj. 积习难改的
words.example: He was suffering from chronic bronchitis.
words.exampleTranslation: 他患有慢性支气管炎。

words.translation: adj. 有毒的， 因中毒引起的
words.example: Many pesticides are highly toxic.
words.exampleTranslation: 许多杀虫剂毒性很大。

words.translation: n. 竞赛， 争夺；争夺， 与…竞争；vt. 对…提出质疑， 辩驳
words.example: The contest should be very keenly fought.
words.exampleTranslation: 比赛应该争夺很激烈。

words.translation: n. 著作家， 作者
words.example: Who is your favourite author?
words.exampleTranslation: 你最喜欢哪位作家？

words.translation: 杠，杠杆；n. 途径，手段，工具；vt. 撬动， 撬起
words.example: He pulled the lever and set the machine in motion.
words.exampleTranslation: 他扳动操纵杆，启动了机器。

words.translation: 保护， 维持； 保存， 保藏；vt. 腌制
words.example: We need to preserve the forest.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们需要保护森林。

words.translation: 建立， 设立； 确立；vt. 证实
words.example: Ukraine indicated that it would establish its own army, 400,000 strong.
words.exampleTranslation: 乌克兰表示它将建立自己的军队，多达40万人。

words.translation: 扩大； 扩充； 扩张；n. 膨胀
words.example: The company intends a slow-down in expansion.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司准备放慢扩展速度。

words.translation: 猛拧，猛扭；挣脱；vt. 使扭伤；痛苦， 难受； 猛扭， 猛拉；n. 扳手
words.example: Leaving home was a terrible wrench for me.
words.exampleTranslation: 对我来说离开家是件十分痛苦的事。

words.translation: adj. 有关的， 切题的
words.example: Do you have the relevant experience?
words.exampleTranslation: 你有相关的经历吗？

words.translation: v. 扩大， 膨胀
words.example: We have to expand the size of the image.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们不得不扩大图像的尺寸。

words.translation: n&vi. 凝视， 盯， 注视
words.example: His gaze settled on her face.
words.exampleTranslation: 他的目光落在她脸上。

words.translation: 宣告， 宣布， 声明；vt. 显示
words.example: The details of her skeleton proclaim her human affinity.
words.exampleTranslation: 她骨骼的细节证明了她与人类的密切关系。

words.translation: 地方行政官， 地方法官；n. 治安官
words.example: She will face a local magistrate on Tuesday.
words.exampleTranslation: 她将在星期二面见一位地方治安法官。

words.translation: 重新得到， 取回， 收回； 挽回， 补救；vi. 检索
words.example: There was absolutely no way that we were going to be able to retrieve it.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们绝对不可能把它找回来。

words.translation: 俯瞰， 眺望； 全面审视， 调查；v. 测量， 勘定；n. [sə'veɪ]
words.example: This very thorough survey goes back to 1784.
words.exampleTranslation: 这项非常彻底的调查可追溯到1784年。

words.translation: vt. 危及， 危害
words.example: By capping her grades at 94 while most other teachers grade on a scale that tops out at 100, your teacher could jeopardize a student's chance of getting a scholarship or getting into a top college.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果你的老师把自己的成绩限制在94分，而其他大多数老师的评分范围都在100分以上，那么你的老师可能会危及学生获得奖学金或进入顶尖大学的机会。

words.translation: 当间谍；vi. 暗中监视；n. 间谍；vt. 看见， 发现
words.example: He was denounced as a foreign spy.
words.exampleTranslation: 有人告发他是外国间谍。

words.translation: 取代， 替代；vt. 迫使…离开家园， 使离开原位
words.example: Renewable energy will have to displace fossil fuels to a much greater extent in the future to avoid unacceptable climate risks.
words.exampleTranslation: 为了避免难以容忍的气候风险，未来可再生能源将不得不在更大程度上取代化石燃料。

words.translation: adj. 占主导地位的， 显著的
words.example: Mandy's predominant emotion was confusion.
words.exampleTranslation: 曼迪的主导情绪是困惑。

words.translation: 烹饪法， 食谱；n. 方法， 秘诀， 诀窍
words.example: What's her recipe for success?
words.exampleTranslation: 她成功的秘诀是什么？

words.translation: n. 思想， 思想意识
words.example: He attributed the party's lack of success to an overemphasis on ideology and ideas.
words.exampleTranslation: 他将该党的不成功归咎与过分强调意识形态和观点。

words.translation: 心理的， 精神的， 思想上的； 精神病的；adj. 智力的
words.example: We're worried about his mental state.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们担心他的精神状况。

words.translation: 像样的， 过得去的， 体面的； 宽厚的， 大方的； 正派的；adj. 合乎礼仪的， 得体的
words.example: He did the decent thing and resigned.
words.exampleTranslation: 他做得很体面，辞职了。

words.translation: 缝， 接缝；n. 煤层
words.example: The skirt ripped along a seam.
words.exampleTranslation: 那条裙子沿一条缝合线裂开了。

words.translation: v. 调查， 研究
words.example: He felt impelled to investigate further.
words.exampleTranslation: 他觉得有必要作进一步调查。

words.translation: adj. 种族的， 人种的
words.example: Racial prejudice is (an) anathema to me.
words.exampleTranslation: 对我来说，种族歧视非常可恶。

words.translation: 幻想， 错误的观念；n. 错觉， 幻觉， 假象
words.example: Mirrors in a room often give an illusion of space.
words.exampleTranslation: 房间里的镜子常给人一种空间增大的错觉。

words.translation: 相当大的；adj. 重要的
words.example: Damage to the building was considerable.
words.exampleTranslation: 对这栋建筑物的损坏相当严重。

words.translation: 生产力；n. 生产率
words.example: We need to increase productivity.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们需要提高生产力。

words.translation: 论点， 主张； 建议， 提案；n. 命题
words.example: How did you vote on Proposition 8?
words.exampleTranslation: 对于第8项修正案你是怎么投的票？

words.translation: 保留，留存；vt. 预订；储备； 保留； 拘谨， 矜持； 替补队员； 后备部队；n. 自然保护区
words.example: I'll reserve a table for five.
words.exampleTranslation: 我要预订一个5人的餐位。

words.translation: 残暴的，凶猛的，粗鲁的；adj. 未开化的，野蛮的；n. 野蛮人，粗鲁的人；乱咬；vt. 激烈抨击
words.example: She had been badly hurt in what police described as 'a savage attack'.
words.exampleTranslation: 她遭受袭击而身受重伤—警方称这是一次“野蛮的袭击”。

words.translation: n. 堆， 大量
words.example: His clothes lay in a heap on the floor.
words.exampleTranslation: 他的衣服堆在地板上。

words.translation: 同情； 一致；n. 支持， 赞同
words.example: She was angling for sympathy.
words.exampleTranslation: 她有意博取同情。

words.translation: n. 消费者， 用户， 消耗者
words.example: We are living in a consumer culture.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们生活在一种消费文化之中。

words.translation: n. 跛子，伤残人；使跛， 使受伤致残；vt. 严重削弱， 使陷入瘫痪
words.example: A total cutoff of supplies would cripple the country's economy.
words.exampleTranslation: 全面终止供给将使该国经济瘫痪。

words.translation: adj. 简短的，短暂的；vt. 向…介绍基本情况，做…的提要；n. 概要， 摘要
words.example: He let out a brief cackle.
words.exampleTranslation: 他发出短暂的咯咯声。

words.translation: vt. 安慰，慰问；n. 控制台， 操纵台
words.example: I can console myself with the fact that I'm not alone.
words.exampleTranslation: 我可以用不只我一个人的这种事实来安慰自己。

words.translation: 主动性， 首创精神； 主动的行动， 倡议；n. 主动权
words.example: We have the initiative; we intend to keep it.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们拥有主动权；我们想要保持主动权。

words.translation: 重新获得， 挽回；v. 恢复
words.example: The economy is at last beginning to recover.
words.exampleTranslation: 经济终于开始复苏了。

words.translation: adv. 顺时针方向地
words.example: She walked clockwise around the circle.
words.exampleTranslation: 她绕着圈顺时针走。

words.translation: 上船；vi. 着手， 开始工作
words.example: Some forethought and preparation is necessary before you embark on the project.
words.exampleTranslation: 你着手进行这个项目之前必须有所考虑，有所准备。

words.translation: 药物治疗；n. 药物
words.example: Medication is used sparingly.
words.exampleTranslation: 药物治疗使用得很少。

words.translation: 钻， 打；v. 训练；钻头；n. 操练，训练
words.example: The drill has variable speed control.
words.exampleTranslation: 这钻机有变速控制。

words.translation: 不和， 抵触；n. 摩擦
words.example: The pistons are graphite-coated to reduce friction.
words.exampleTranslation: 活塞表面涂有石墨以减少摩擦。

words.translation: vi. 商谈，商议；vt. 授予， 赋予
words.example: He wanted to confer with his colleagues before reaching a decision.
words.exampleTranslation: 他想与他的同事先商议一下再作出决定。

words.translation: 聪明的；adj. 理智的
words.example: She's formidably intelligent.
words.exampleTranslation: 她聪明绝顶。

words.translation: 店员；n. 办事员， 职员
words.example: It was strange, how invisible a clerk could feel.
words.exampleTranslation: 很奇怪一名职员会感到如此地受人忽视。

words.translation: 承认， 承认…的权威； 告知收到， 确认；vt. 对…表示谢意， 报偿
words.example: She refuses to acknowledge the need for reform.
words.exampleTranslation: 她拒不承认改革的必要性。

words.translation: 装备， 配备；vt. 使有准备
words.example: She got a bank loan to rent and equip a small workshop.
words.exampleTranslation: 她取得一笔银行贷款来租用和装备一个小车间。

words.translation: adj. 恭敬的， 恭顺的
words.example: The use of deferential language is symbolic of the Confucian ideal of the woman, which dominates conservative gender norms in Japan.
words.exampleTranslation: 使用恭敬的语言是儒家理想女性的象征，在日本保守的性别规范中占主导地位。

words.translation: 手稿， 原稿， 底稿；n. 手写本
words.example: I read her poems in manuscript.
words.exampleTranslation: 我读过她的诗作的手稿。

words.translation: 奢侈；n. 奢侈品
words.example: The room had an air of luxury.
words.exampleTranslation: 房间具有豪华的气派。

words.translation: 推翻，打倒；vt. 使终止，摒弃；n. 推翻， 终止， 结束
words.example: I knew you would overthrow me in the end.
words.exampleTranslation: 我早知道你最终会把我打倒。

words.translation: 编结， 编织；vi. 愈合；编结，编织；使紧密地结合，使紧凑；vt. 皱紧，皱
words.example: Knit one row, purl one row.
words.exampleTranslation: 织一趟平针，织一趟反针。

words.translation: 把…强加给；vt. 使…遭受， 使…承担
words.example: Do you have to inflict that music on us?
words.exampleTranslation: 你非得逼我们听那种音乐吗？

words.translation: adj. 值得花时间做的
words.example: The smile on her face made it all worthwhile.
words.exampleTranslation: 她脸上的笑容使得这一切都非常值得。

words.translation: adv. 在内地， 向内地；adj. 内陆的， 内地的
words.example: The vast majority live further inland.
words.exampleTranslation: 大多数人居住在更远的内陆。

words.translation: 绊脚， 绊倒； 跌跌撞撞地走；vi. 结结巴巴
words.example: I hope you don't stumble over any event during the holiday.
words.exampleTranslation: 我希望您不要绊倒在假期中的任何事件上。

words.translation: 特产， 名产， 特色菜；n. 专业， 专长
words.example: Her specialty is taxation law.
words.exampleTranslation: 她的专长是税法。

words.translation: vi. 变化， 有差异；vt. 改变，使多样化
words.example: Her novels vary in length.
words.exampleTranslation: 她的小说篇幅长短不一。

words.translation: 乐意地， 欣然地； 容易地；adv. 很快地， 立即
words.example: The components are readily available in hardware stores.
words.exampleTranslation: 这些零件在五金商店容易买到。

words.translation: 条理清楚的， 连贯的；adj. 一致的， 协调的
words.example: The subjects of the curriculum form a coherent whole.
words.exampleTranslation: 课程中的科目构成了一个连贯的整体。

words.translation: 性交；n. 交流， 交往， 交际
words.example: There was social intercourse between the old and the young.
words.exampleTranslation: 老年人和年轻人之间有社会交往。

words.translation: 方便；n. 便利设施
words.example: They may use a credit card for convenience.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们可以为了方便而使用信用卡。

words.translation: 得体；宽容，大方；正派，合乎礼仪，体面；n.
words.example: His sense of decency forced him to resign.
words.exampleTranslation: 他的正派作风迫使他辞职。

words.translation: 谬误， 虚假；n. 谎言， 说谎
words.example: She called the verdict a victory of truth over falsehood.
words.exampleTranslation: 她称该裁定是一个真实对虚假的胜利。

words.translation: 纪律，训练；惩罚；n. 学科；训练；vt. 惩罚， 处罚
words.example: Discipline was the new coach's secret weapon.
words.exampleTranslation: 严格的训练是这位新教练的秘密武器。

words.translation: v. 思索， 考虑， 沉思
words.example: CubeSat researchers suggest that now's the time to ponder unexpected and unintended possible consequences of more people than ever having access to their own small slice of space.
words.exampleTranslation: 立方体卫星（CubeSat）的研究人员认为，由于有机会进入属于自己的小宇宙空间的人前所未有地多了起来，现在是时候考虑一下其带来的意料及计划外的后果了。

words.translation: adj. 客观的， 无偏见的；n. 目标，目的
words.example: What is the main objective of this project?
words.exampleTranslation: 这个项目的主要目标是什么？

words.translation: 用， 尽；vt. 运用， 行使
words.example: A number of neurotransmitters exert their effects by first increasing cyclic AMP concentrations in target neurons.
words.exampleTranslation: 许多神经递质首先通过增加靶神经元中的循环 AMP 浓度来发挥其作用。

words.translation: 丑事， 丑闻； 流言蜚语；n. 反感， 愤慨
words.example: The press could scent a scandal.
words.exampleTranslation: 记者觉察出有桩丑闻。

words.translation: adj. 混合成的，综合成的；合成物；n. 复合材料
words.example: Spain is a composite of multifarious traditions and people.
words.exampleTranslation: 西班牙是多种传统和多个民族的合成体。

words.translation: vt. 阻碍， 妨碍
words.example: Unfortunately these drugs are quite toxic and hinder the body's ability to fight off infection.
words.exampleTranslation: 不幸的是，这些药毒性很大，妨碍身体抗感染的能力。

words.translation: 香味，气味；臭迹；踪迹，线索；n. 香水；vt. 嗅到， 察觉
words.example: The dogs must have lost her scent.
words.exampleTranslation: 狗准是闻不到她的气味了。

words.translation: 估计；vt. 评价；估计； 评价；n. 看法
words.example: My estimate was bang on target.
words.exampleTranslation: 我的估计完全准确。

words.translation: n. 毕业文凭， 毕业证书， 资格证书
words.example: Satisfactory completion of the course will lead to the award of the Diploma of Social Work.
words.exampleTranslation: 合格完成此课程者将获得社会福利工作文凭。

words.translation: 显示；vt. 陈列，展览；n. 展览品
words.example: This exhibit was kindly loaned by the artist's family.
words.exampleTranslation: 这件展品是艺术家的家人惠借而展出的。

words.translation: n. 商标，牌子；铭刻， 打烙印于；vt. 加污名于， 谴责
words.example: She bought her car brand new.
words.exampleTranslation: 她买的汽车是全新的。

words.translation: 暂停， 中止； 暂令停止参加， 暂时剥夺； 悬架， 悬置机构； 悬浮液；n. 悬， 挂， 吊
words.example: The car's improved suspension gives you a smoother ride.
words.exampleTranslation: 汽车悬架经过改进，乘坐起来更平稳。

words.translation: n. 酒精， 乙醇
words.example: Wine contains about 10% alcohol.
words.exampleTranslation: 葡萄酒含有约10%的酒精。

words.translation: adj. 不可避免的， 必然的
words.example: You have to accept the inevitable.
words.exampleTranslation: 你得接受必然发生的事。

words.translation: vt. 否定， 拒绝相信
words.example: Who can deny the justice of their cause?
words.exampleTranslation: 谁能否认他们的追求是合理的呢？

words.translation: n. 沟， 沟渠
