words.translation: 标准， 规范；n. 准则
words.example: How did smiling in photographs become a post-Victorian norm?
words.exampleTranslation: 照片中的笑容是如何成为后维多利亚时代的行为准则的？

words.translation: 使冷凝， 使凝结；vt. 浓缩， 压缩， 简缩
words.example: When you summarize, you condense an extended idea or argument into a sentence or more in your own words.
words.exampleTranslation: 总结的时候，用自己的话把拓展了的观念或论据简缩成一句或几句话。

words.translation: 推动， 促进， 刺激；n. 推动力
words.example: By 1982, she was restless and needed a new impetus for her talent.
words.exampleTranslation: 到1982年，她焦躁不安，需要一个新的对其才华的推动力。

words.translation: n. 愤怒， 愤慨， 义愤
words.example: He could scarcely keep in his indignation.
words.exampleTranslation: 他几乎控制不住自己的愤怒。

words.translation: 栅栏； 检票口； 屏障；n. 障碍， 隔阂
words.example: I realized I had to surmount the language barrier.
words.exampleTranslation: 我认识到我必须得克服语言障碍。

words.translation: 现实的； 实际可行的；adj. 现实主义的， 逼真的
words.example: We are now far more sober and realistic.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们现在严肃多了，也现实多了。

words.translation: 使转向， 使改道； 转移， 转移…的注意力；vt. 使娱乐， 使消遣
words.example: Even using a "hands-free" device can divert a driver's attention to an alarming extent.
words.exampleTranslation: 即使使用“免提”设备，也会在令人担忧的程度上转移司机的注意力。

words.translation: adj. 显眼的， 明显的
words.example: Most people don't want to be too conspicuous.
words.exampleTranslation: 大多数人不愿过于显眼。

words.translation: n. 诗， 诗句
words.example: This verse describes three signs of spring.
words.exampleTranslation: 这节诗描述了春天的3个征兆。

words.translation: adj. 犯罪的， 刑事的；n. 犯人，罪犯，刑事犯
words.example: He specialized in criminal law.
words.exampleTranslation: 他专攻刑法。

words.translation: 狂怒的， 暴怒的；adj. 强烈的， 激烈的
words.example: He risked a glance at her furious face.
words.exampleTranslation: 他壮着胆子瞅了瞅她那张愤怒的脸。

words.translation: n. 过度肥胖
words.example: Obesity can increase the risk of heart disease.
words.exampleTranslation: 肥胖会增加患心脏病的危险。

words.translation: vi. 晒成棕褐色；使晒成棕褐色；vt. 硝制；棕褐色， 棕黄色；n. 晒成棕褐色， 晒黑
words.example: It's safer to fake a tan with make-up rather than subject your complexion to the harsh rays of the sun.
words.exampleTranslation: 用化妆来伪造棕褐色的皮肤比让皮肤暴露于强烈的太阳光线更安全。

words.translation: 个别的；adj. 独特的；n. 个人， 个体
words.example: Some individual investors exulted at the record.
words.exampleTranslation: 一些个人投资者为这一记录欢欣鼓舞。

words.translation: n. 公文包， 公事包
words.example: He was carrying a briefcase.
words.exampleTranslation: 他提着公文包。

words.translation: 讨厌的人；n. 麻烦事
words.example: He could be a bit of a nuisance when he was drunk.
words.exampleTranslation: 他喝醉时会是一个有点令人讨厌的人。

words.translation: 做好准备；vi. 振作精神；使防备，使受锻炼；vt. 支住，撑牢，使绷紧；n. 支架， 托架
words.example: Overhead, the lights showed the old timbers, used to brace the roof.
words.exampleTranslation: 在头顶上，光线照射出支撑屋顶的旧木头。

words.translation: 限制， 约束；vt. 克制， 抑制
words.example: Parents shouldn't completely constrain children's viewing.
words.exampleTranslation: 父母不应完全限制儿童观看节目。

words.translation: 轻快的， 生气勃勃的； 兴隆的， 繁忙活跃的；adj. 寒冷而清新的
words.example: A brisk walk should blow the cobwebs away.
words.exampleTranslation: 轻快的散步可以使人头脑清醒。

words.translation: n. 威信， 威望
words.example: It was his responsibility for foreign affairs that gained him international prestige.
words.exampleTranslation: 是他在外交事务中的尽职尽责为他赢得了国际声望。

words.translation: n. 绝缘
words.example: Better insulation of your home will help to reduce heating bills.
words.exampleTranslation: 增加房子的隔热性能会有助于减少供暖费用。

words.translation: 细绳， 粗线， 索；n. 灯芯绒裤
words.example: He began to worry at the knot in the cord.
words.exampleTranslation: 他开始解绳子上的结。

words.translation: vt. 使惊吓， 使吃惊
words.example: Sometimes a sudden shift in color can be used to startle potential predators or threaten intruders.
words.exampleTranslation: 有时候，色彩的快速变换可以用来惊吓掠食者或威胁入侵者。

words.translation: adj. 暂时的，临时的；n. 间歇， 过渡期间
words.example: The power-balance has evened out in the interim government.
words.exampleTranslation: 临时政府内的权力平衡已持平。

words.translation: 欺诈， 诈骗；n. 骗子
words.example: This is a clear case of fraud.
words.exampleTranslation: 这无疑是一桩诈骗案。

words.translation: 证词；n. 见证， 证明
words.example: Can I refuse to give testimony?
words.exampleTranslation: 我能拒绝作证吗？

words.translation: n. 理事会， 委员会
words.example: The members left the council chamber.
words.exampleTranslation: 议员离开了会议厅。

words.translation: 重申；vt. 再确认
words.example: The North Atlantic Treaty begins with the affirmation that its parties "reaffirm their faith in the purposes and principles of the Charter of the United Nations."
words.exampleTranslation: 《北大西洋公约》以公开肯定其成员“重申其对《联合国宪章》的目的以及原则的信念”开头。

words.translation: 实施， 执行；vt. 强制， 强迫， 迫使
words.example: The legislation will be difficult to enforce.
words.exampleTranslation: 这一法规将难以实施。

words.translation: vi. 闪闪发光，闪耀；闪光， 灿烂的光辉；n. 耀眼， 辉煌
words.example: There was a triumphant glitter in his eyes.
words.exampleTranslation: 他眼睛里闪烁着胜利的光辉。

words.translation: 命中注定的， 预定的；adj. 以…为目的地的
words.example: It will come as no surprise to learn that the main candidates spent their largest sums on flyers, leaflets, posters and other bumf destined for the landfill.
words.exampleTranslation: 得知主要的候选人将他们最大的一笔钱花在传单、传单、海报和其他注定要被填埋的垃圾上时，这并不惊讶。

words.translation: n. 压抑， 压制， 镇压
words.example: Everyone should fight against repression and injustice.
words.exampleTranslation: 每个人都应该与压迫和不公作斗争。

words.translation: 易碎的， 脆的， 易损坏的；adj. 虚弱的， 脆弱的
words.example: The economy remains extremely fragile.
words.exampleTranslation: 经济仍然极其脆弱。

words.translation: 处罚， 惩罚；n. 罚金
words.example: He was fouled inside the penalty area.
words.exampleTranslation: 在罚球区内对方队员对他犯规。

words.translation: n. 社会学
words.example: I'll be teaching history and sociology next term.
words.exampleTranslation: 下学期我教历史和社会学。

words.translation: 流放，流亡；n. 被流放者，流亡国外者；vt. 流放， 放逐， 使流亡
words.example: He is now living in exile in Egypt.
words.exampleTranslation: 他现在流亡在埃及。

words.translation: 大小，规模；等级，级别；天平，磅秤；比例；刻度，标度；n. 鳞；vt. 攀登， 爬越
words.example: Many practitioners have a sliding scale of fees.
words.exampleTranslation: 许多从业者都有收费的一种比例标准。

words.translation: adj. 巨大的， 庞大的
words.example: The gigantic natural harbour is a haven for boats.
words.exampleTranslation: 这个巨大的天然港是船舶的避风港。

words.translation: 与其他不同的；adj. 清楚的， 明确的
words.example: There was a distinct smell of gas.
words.exampleTranslation: 有一股明显的煤气味。

words.translation: n. 植物， 草木
words.example: We fought our way through the dense vegetation.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们在茂密的植被中开出一条通路。

words.translation: 恢复， 痊愈；n. 追回， 寻回， 收复
words.example: Economic recovery is here.
words.exampleTranslation: 经济复苏现在开始了。

words.translation: 地质学；n. 地质情况
words.example: We went on a geology field trip.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们去进行地质野外考察。

words.translation: vt. 举起，升起，吊起；起重器械；n. 举起， 升起， 吊起
words.example: He uses a hydraulic hoist to unload two empty barrels.
words.exampleTranslation: 他用一架液压起重机卸下两只空桶。

words.translation: adj. 知道的， 意识到的
words.example: She is aware of her own failings.
words.exampleTranslation: 她了解自己的弱点。

words.translation: n. 夸脱
words.example: He stepped out to buy a quart of milk.
words.exampleTranslation: 他出去买了一夸脱奶。

words.translation: 数字的； 用数字表示的；adj. 数值的
words.example: Numerical increases are used as quantifiable indicators of heightened interest in the new stimulus.
words.exampleTranslation: 数值的增长被用来作为显示新型激励下增长利益的量化指标。

words.translation: vi. 一瘸一拐地走，蹒跚；软弱的，无生气的，无精神的；adj. 软的，松沓的；n. 跛行
words.example: I wasn't badly hurt, but I injured my thigh and had to limp.
words.exampleTranslation: 我伤得并不严重，但我伤到了大腿，不得不一瘸一拐地走路。

words.translation: 安全， 保障； 抵押品；n. 证券
words.example: He was upgraded to security guard.
words.exampleTranslation: 他被提升为保安。

words.translation: 奖，奖品；n. 判定；授予， 给予；vt. 判给， 裁定
words.example: He got an award for bravery.
words.exampleTranslation: 他因英勇受奖。

words.translation: vi. 猛然弓背跃起；美元，澳元；n. 雄鹿，雄兔
words.example: We stayed at Tom's place. It isn't exactly Buck House, but it's comfortable enough.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们待在汤姆那里。那并不是巴克宫，但足够舒适了。

words.translation: 有条件被选中的；adj. 合适的， 合意的
words.example: They are not eligible for sick pay.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们没有资格领病假工资。

words.translation: n. 惊恐，忧虑，警报；vt. 使惊恐， 使担心
words.example: An alarm bell went off.
words.exampleTranslation: 警钟响了。

words.translation: 虚弱的， 衰弱的， 无力的；adj. 无效的， 无益的
words.example: The heartbeat was feeble and irregular.
words.exampleTranslation: 心搏无力，心律不齐。

words.translation: 估计， 估量；n. 评价
words.example: She was honest in her appraisal of her team's chances.
words.exampleTranslation: 她对自己队获胜机会的估计是诚实的。

words.translation: 连续的；adj. 频频的
words.example: She finds the continual confrontation very wearing.
words.exampleTranslation: 她发现持续的对峙使人精疲力竭。

words.translation: 药草， 香草；n. 草本植物
words.example: The dried herb is obtainable from health shops.
words.exampleTranslation: 这种干药草在保健店里能买到。

words.translation: n. 散文
words.example: Shute's prose is stark and chillingly unsentimental.
words.exampleTranslation: 舒特的散文刻板而冷峻。

words.translation: 肢， 臂， 腿；n. 树枝
words.example: Snake embryos, for example, sprout hind limb buds.
words.exampleTranslation: 例如，蛇的胚胎会生长出后肢。

words.translation: 方向， 目标， 方位；n. 熟悉情况， 适应， 情况介绍
words.example: His sexual orientation was a lot more gay than straight.
words.exampleTranslation: 他的性取向更像是同性恋的而非异性恋的。

words.translation: 茶点， 点心；n. 恢复， 精神爽快
words.example: May I offer you some refreshment?
words.exampleTranslation: 可以请您吃点喝点什么吗？

words.translation: 信任， 信赖；n. 信心， 自信
words.example: Her confidence had never flagged.
words.exampleTranslation: 她的信心从未减弱。

words.translation: 随心所欲的；adj. 专断的
words.example: He makes unpredictable, arbitrary decisions.
words.exampleTranslation: 他做的决定难以预料，主观武断。

words.translation: 专心的， 专注的；adj. 急切的；n. 意图，意向，目的
words.example: His intent is clearly not to placate his critics.
words.exampleTranslation: 他的目的显然不是要安抚批评他的人。

words.translation: adj. 被动的， 消极的
words.example: His passive attitude made things easier for me.
words.exampleTranslation: 他的被动态度使我办起事来容易多了。

words.translation: n. 肥料
words.example: A top dressing of fertilizer should be added to improve growth as mint impoverishes the soil quickly.
words.exampleTranslation: 应施顶肥以促进生长，因为薄荷会使土壤迅速变得贫瘠。

words.translation: adj. 相应的， 符合的
words.example: A change in the money supply brings a corresponding change in expenditure.
words.exampleTranslation: 货币供应量的改变随即引起支出的相应改变。

words.translation: 誓言， 誓约；n. 咒骂， 诅咒语
words.example: He took an oath of loyalty to the government.
words.exampleTranslation: 他做了效忠于政府的宣誓。

words.translation: 回答， 答复；n. 反应， 响应
words.example: His response was well balanced.
words.exampleTranslation: 他的反应很沉着。

words.translation: n. 条约， 协议， 协定
words.example: The treaty was signed on 24 March.
words.exampleTranslation: 条约是3月24日签订的。

words.translation: 庄严， 端庄；n. 尊严， 高贵
words.example: He sat with such regal dignity.
words.exampleTranslation: 他以王者之尊严就座。

words.translation: 挑战，邀请比赛；艰巨的任务；n. 怀疑，质问；反对， 公然反抗； 向…挑战；vt. 对…质疑
words.example: Bill was stimulated by the challenge.
words.exampleTranslation: 比尔受到该挑战的激励。

words.translation: adj. 竞争的，对抗的；竞争对手，敌手；n. 可与匹敌的人；与…竞争；vt. 与…匹敌， 比得上
words.example: This year the newspaper has outsold its main rival.
words.exampleTranslation: 今年该报的发行量已超过了它的主要对手。
